{{Quote|You were an estimable Jedi, Quinlan Vos. Once. As was Sora Bulq. As was Count Dooku. Now you all sully the name of Jedi. I, too, had my questions. Every battle I have with fallen Jedi like you answers them. You betray everything you were taught. You betray yourselves. You are faithless&hellip;|[[K'Kruhk]]|<ref name="SWR63">[[Republic 63|''Republic'' 63]]</ref>}}
A '''Dark Acolyte''', also known as a '''dark side apprentice''', was a title granted to any [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] that joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and directly came to serve its [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] Dooku, secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus.

These [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Dark side adept/Legends|adepts]] were embedded in the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] and functioned as anything from [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to [[Spy/Legends|spies]] to civilian [[Commander/Legends|commanders]], depending on individual vocations, but all operated first and foremost as the Confederacy's enforcers. Though all trained in the [[Code of the Sith|Sith arts]] by Tyranus, none could claim the mantle of Sith due to the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]].

Most of the these disciples would become casualties of the war, and eventually even Tyranus was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
{{Quote|You will have to deal with them if you are going to get close to Dooku. He sets one against the other, but they will unite against a perceived common threat to their position. Approach them carefully.|[[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]]|<ref name="J:CD">''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]''</ref>}}
===Recruitment===
{{Quote|I betrayed the Republic to help you because I believe in your cause&hellip;|Quinlan Vos|<ref name="J:CD" />}}
[[File:CW_Chapter_7.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Tyranus recruits Asajj Ventress.]]
A Dark Acolyte was a rank filled by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] recruited by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], the public personna of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus, and his [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Many of their number were themselves likewise former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], having defected to the Separatist Alliance due to their increasing frustration with the corruption and ineffectiveness of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Some joined out of personal loyalty to Tyranus himself,<ref name="J:CD" /> though others joined out of a misguided fascination with either the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lore, both of which the organization championed.<ref name="J:MW">''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]''</ref><ref name="IJedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref><ref name="OSWFF116">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 116|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 116]] (DOO8, Count Dooku)''</ref> However, some members of the Acolytes had been directly approached by the Dark Lord, and in the case of Force-sensitives who had no prior training, were tutored by Tyranus himself.

Being inducted as a Dark Acolyte appeared to be relatively easy, with most capable Force-wielders being accepted without argument. However, such recruits typically remained minor players within the group until they gained Tyranus' trust, either through displays of fealty or on occasion, the rage-fueled depravity indicative of the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="J:CD" /> Once this was gained, Acolytes were provided with more important assignments and sometimes [[Sith training]].<ref name="SWR63" /><ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref> While not true [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in their own right, and therefore not a violation of the Sith [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], certain members were provided with tutoring in certain elements of Sith knowledge and philosophy. A notable example is [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who was trained in the Sith Quey'tek meditation.<ref name="TCD">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>

===Equipment===
As the enforcers of Tyranus, they served at the whim of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] and adhered strongly to Sith philosophy, many of the types of equipment made available to members were of Sith-design. Most notably were the [[Sith Enforcer]] battle tanks. Each of these craft were armed with a pair of supercharged [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] and two [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]]. Though effective in one-on-one attacks, Darth Tyranus insisted that they travel in groups of three for improved effectiveness.<ref name="TCWvg">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> All members of the organization were provided with [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|red synth-crystals]] for their lightsabers, and most wielded these proudly.<ref name="TCWn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> Notably, Quinlan Vos was provided with the crystal originally used by [[Darth Andeddu]].<ref name="SWR63" /> However, some members chose to continue to use the [[Ilum crystal/Legends|Ilum crystals]] they carried as Jedi, particularly if they were operating as infiltrators and spies within the Jedi Order.<ref name="J:MW" /><ref name="IJedi" />

[[File:DookuVosAndeddusCrystal-Republic63.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Tyranus presents Quinlan Vos with Darth Andeddu's lightsaber crystal.]]
Beyond these standards, the equipment and weapons used was left to their personal discretion, due to the various roles they performed within the CIS' [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]]. Those who publicly displayed themselves on the battlefield, such as [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] or [[Tol Skorr]], typically opted for some type of armor.<ref name="Monster" /><ref name="TDOR">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili]]''</ref> Asajj Ventress, who usually worked as an assassin or covert operative, favored variations on a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Leather/Legends|Leather]] jumpsuits and long combat skirts.<ref name="TCD" /> [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], uniquely, continued to favor his original [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]], even after being ousted as a Dark Acolyte, and only chose to distinguish himself by adopting the standard red lightsabers.<ref name="J:CD" />

===Ideology===
{{Quote|I'm here because I think the Republic is hopelessly corrupt and must be replaced. In that respect, I am still a Jedi, as are you.|Quinlan Vos to Darth Tyranus|<ref name="J:CD" />}}
A Dark Acolyte had little in the way of formalized ideology or philosophical teachings, and was for the most part motivated by a simple opposition to the Jedi and their teachings. Overall, a Dark Acolyte desired the overthrowing of the Galactic Republic, with many of the former Jedi constituents especially being exasperated by its bureaucracy and greed. Quinlan Vos cited that since this desire was rooted in their disgust with the Republic's corruption rather than a thirst for power, they were still acting in accordance with Jedi teachings.<ref name="J:CD" />

However, each Dark Acolyte was strongly influenced by Sith philosophy, and was deeply rooted in the dark side of the Force due to this. Tyranus cited during [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|his meeting]] with Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] that since all beings carried the dark side within themselves, turning to it was simply to acknowledge another part of one's self, and was not in itself inherently evil.<ref name="Y:DarkRendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> In a separate exchange with Quinlan Vos, Darth Tyranus stated that the Jedi's refusal to use the dark side was motivated by fear of it, and if the Jedi simply stopped fearing it, they could use it to correct the injustices of the galaxy.<ref name="J:CD" /> However, as Tyranus was a fully-fledged [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] at the time, his beliefs cannot be taken to represent the attitudes of the Dark Acolytes as a whole. In fact, many were capable of partaking in spectacular displays of depravity with only the flimsiest of justifications.<ref name="J:MW" /><ref name="Monster" /> [[Nikkos Tyris]], notably, was of the opinion that the attainment of strength and power eliminated the need for any justification at all; a Sith ideal.<ref name="IJedi" />

==List of Dark Acolytes==
===Artel Darc===
[[File:Arteldarc.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Artel Darc}}
'''[[Artel Darc]]''' commanded the Confederate legions on [[Dagu]], where he enslaved the [[Rybet/Legends|Rybet]] inhabitants. His activities drew the attention of the Republic, and a military force led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] [[Battle of Dagu|attacked Dagu]]. Darc led his forces against the Republic in the ensuing skirmish.<ref name="OSWFF116" />

===Asajj Ventress===
{{Main|Asajj Ventress/Legends}}
[[File:Ventress_TDS.jpg|right|150px]]
[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|'''Asajj Ventress''']] was arguably the most prominent member of the Dark Acolytes, even receiving an introduction to Darth Tyranus's own [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. A [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] sold to [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattataki]] slavers, Ventress became a powerful [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] on the blood-soaked world.<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref><ref name="SWR60">[[Republic 60|''Republic'' 60]]</ref> When Tyranus arrived onplanet during the weeks following the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ventress challenged him, impressing him with her lightsaber skills despite being soundly beaten.<ref name="CWC7">{{CW|7}}</ref> After becoming one of the Dark Lord's top lieutenants, she operated primarily as a commander and even an administrator, being frequently teamed with the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] and leading military campaigns on [[Battle of Ohma-D'un|Ohma-D'un]] and [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Teth]], to name a few,<ref name="SWR51">[[Republic 51|''Republic'' 51]]</ref><ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> as well as being given control of the [[swamp gas]] production facility on [[Queyta]], though her main vocation was that of assassin and spy.<ref name="SWR53">[[Republic 53|''Republic'' 53]]</ref><ref name="CoD">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref><ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>

===Dark Acolyte Trio===
{{Main|Dark Acolyte Trio}}
The '''Dark Acolyte trio''' were a group of anonymous acolytes who participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. Their origins and identities were unknown. During the battle, they helped cover Tyranus' retreat by guarding the ground entrance to [[Dooku's hangar/Legends|the Dark Lord's private hangar]]. Piloting [[Sith Enforcer]] battle tanks, they came into conflict with Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and all three perished, but they succeeded in delaying him long enough for Tyranus to escape.<ref name="TCWvg" />

===Doppelgänger of Darth Tyranus===
{{Main|Doppelgänger of Dooku}}
It is unknown how these '''replicas''' of Darth Tyranus came into being, whether as a [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] experiment or a [[Dopplegänger|Force-based construct/illusion]], but they served as members of the true Dark Lord's acolytes. Compared to the genuine article, these replicas served largely mundane purposes, one being assigned to guard [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor's]] [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droid]] [[Droid factory (disambiguation)|factory]] on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]], while another was stationed at Tyranus' homeworld of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. Both were slain by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="TNDA">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref> who also eventually killed the real Darth Tyranus during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] near the end of the Clone Wars.<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

===Kadrian Sey===
[[File:KadrianSey-tattoos.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Kadrian Sey}}
When the Clone Wars began, the Jedi '''Kadrian Sey''' essentially vanished, failing to report to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. One of Darth Tyranus' earliest known recruits, Sey served as a personal bodyguard for the Dark Lord, alongside Tol Skorr. She and Skorr enjoyed a tense relationship, being set against one another by Tyranus, but both would unite against a perceived threat to their position.<ref name="J:CD" />

===Karoc===
[[File:Karoc.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Karoc}}
Alongside his [[Twin/Legends|twin brother]], Vinoc, '''Karoc''' was one of Darth Tyranus' servants. He and his sibling evidently had a low rank within the organization, and were assigned the relatively mundane duty of guarding the [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droid]] [[Droid factory (disambiguation)|factory]] on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. Unfortunately for Karoc and his twin, they were confronted by the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, who killed both in the ensuing lightsaber duel.<ref name="TNDA" />

===Kern===
[[File:Kern-KSW.jpg|right|100x100px]]
{{Main|Kern (Dark Acolyte)}}
'''Kern''' was a male [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who wielded a red [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]. He and another Dark Acolyte [[Ror]] lead the [[Attack on Kashyyyk]] with the main objective of destroying the Jedi Outpost on the world and the capture of Jedi Master [[Mavra Zane]] and her Padawans. He then was present on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] where the Jedi Master and her padawans were to be executed but they freed themselves with the help of [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and the [[Star Runner]]. After engaging in a duel Kern was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by one of [[Mavra Zane]]'s padawans.<ref name="KSW">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>

===Quinlan Vos===
[[File:QuinlanHS.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Quinlan Vos/Legends}}
The Jedi Master '''Quinlan Vos''' was dispatched by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to infiltrate the Dark Acolytes as a double agent, and while he was accepted with open arms, he was relegated to more mundane assignments and minor errands due to Darth Tyranus' lack of trust in him. Vos confronted the Dark Lord over this, and was rewarded with renewed favor and lessons in the dark side of the Force. Vos was part of Tyranus' retinue of Acolytes that accompanied him to [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]] to negotiate with [[Sheyf]] [[Tinté Vos]], exposing himself as a double-agent to protect his aunt when the Dark Lord ordered her assassination. Tyranus momentarily incapacitated him before revealing that he had known of Vos' role all along, before further revealing Tinté' involvement in the death of Quinlan's parents. Quinlan Vos butchered his aunt in a violent rage, genuinely turning to the dark side, and was fully accepted into the fold.<ref name="J:CD" />

===Ror===
[[File:Ror_KSW.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Ror}}
'''Ror''' was a male [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who wielded a red [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]. Alongside his fellow Dark Acolyte [[Kern (Dark Acolyte)|Kern]] lead the [[Attack on Kashyyyk]] with the help of trandoshans during the first year of the Clone Wars. Later he was present on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] during the [[Rebellion on Felucia|rebellion]] where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by one of [[Mavra Zane]]'s padawans.<ref name="KSW" />

===Saato===
[[File:Saato-SW_The_New_Droid_Army.png|right|100px]]
{{Main|Saato}}
'''Saato''' was a [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] coerced by Darth Tyranus to his cause. While offered a limited military command, Saato's primary role appeared to be counter-intelligence, as shown by her apprehension of Republic spy [[Raala Ponchar]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She had no qualms about hiring [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], using [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to help capture the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker when he was sent to rescue Ponchar. Skywalker and Ponchar escaped, and Saato pursued the former to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], but was bested and slain in a lightsaber duel.

===Savage Opress===
[[File:SavageOpressHS-WOTM.png|right|100px]]
{{Main|Savage Opress/Legends}}
Effectively recruited as a replacement for Asajj Ventress after Darth Sidious ordered her execution, '''Savage Opress''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] born into the [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]], essentially as a slave to the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. Reinforced by [[Dathomir Magic|Nightsister "Shadow Magic"]], Opress was presented to Darth Tyranus ostensibly as a new apprentice, but in truth as an agent of the vengeful Asajj Ventress. Opress' initial assignment was the seizure of the [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]], a task Opress completed with brutal efficiency. Greatly satisfied with Opress, Tyranus immediately took him under his wing, training him as a true [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], believing they could one day rival Sidious.<ref name="WotM">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

===Sev'rance Tann===
[[File:Sevrance_tann.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Sev'rance Tann/Legends}}
'''Sev'rance Tann''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who left [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] to become a Dark Acolyte and [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the Clone Wars. Hailing from [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], with the aid of Darth Sidious she became one of few Chiss to leave her people during her time, along with her lover [[Vandalor]], both becoming minions of their patron's apprentice, Darth Tyranus, and the Confederacy shortly before the outbreak of the Clone Wars in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Tyranus taught Tann the use of the dark side, and she became one of his most trusted lieutenants. A tactical genius, Tann served primarily as a military commander.<ref name="GBcc">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>

===Sora Bulq===
[[File:BulqHeadshot.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Sora Bulq/Legends}}
Thought dead during the Battle of Geonosis, the Jedi Master '''Sora Bulq''' emerged accompanying [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] to [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. There, they both confronted Darth Tyranus, himself having just fled Geonosis and fresh from an engagement with Yoda. Despite the advanced skills of both Jedi, they were overcome. Taken and treated for his injuries by Tyranus, Bulq was swayed to his cause and recruited into the Acolytes. He rescued the wounded Tholme and returned to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] as an enemy operative, and was tasked with creating a schism within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="CWV8">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume 8: The Last Siege, the Final Truth]]''</ref> The scheme was exposed by Jedi Master Mace Windu, squandering Bulq's potential as a double-agent, though this allowed him to become one of the most prominent and capable of the Dark Acolytes.<ref name="J:MW" /> Sora Bulq was made secondary leader of the Dark Acolytes shortly afterwards.<ref name="cswe Bulq">{{CSWECite|I|97|Bulq, Sora}}</ref> He was often at Tyranus' side during the war, acting as bodyguard and advisor, though he was occasionally trusted with high-level administration and government positions.<ref name="J:CD" />

===Tol Skorr===
[[File:TolSkorr.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Tol Skorr}}
A former Jedi, '''Tol Skorr''' was shot down by pirates above [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], but was rescued by Tyranus. Developing a strong loyalty to his savior, Skorr followed Tyranus unquestioningly ever since, even leaving the Jedi Order and defecting to the Confederacy. A faithful acolyte, Skorr served primarily as one of Tyranus' bodyguards, alongside Kadrian Sey. Set against one another by the Dark Lord, the two enjoyed a tense relationship, though as Jedi Master Tholme noted, they would unite against a perceived threat to their positions.<ref name="J:CD" /> After Kadrian Sey's death, Quinlan Vos became Skorr's nemesis within the Acolytes, the two jockeying for Tyranus' approval.<ref name="SWR63" />

===Trenox===
[[File:Trenox.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Trenox}}
The Dark Acolyte known as '''Trenox''' was involved in the [[Coruscant Insurrection]], helping Darth Tyranus command the Confederate forces during the battle. Encountering Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, Trenox fled from him into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underlevels]]. He encountered and threatened [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], though the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] managed to evade him, and Trenox was again confronted by Skywalker within a [[Club/Legends|club]]. After a brief duel, the acolyte opted to flee again, escaping on a speeder bike. Trenox accompanied Tyranus into the Jedi Temple, and again was confronted by Anakin Skywalker. This time, Trenox stood his ground, and the two fought long against one another. However, Trenox was ultimately cut down.<ref name="TNDA" />

===Vinoc===
[[File:Vinoc.jpg|right|100px]]
{{Main|Vinoc}}
The twin brother of Karoc, '''Vinoc''' also counted among Darth Tyranus' Dark Acolytes. The siblings appeared to prefer operating in partnership with one another, and shared duties. They evidently were of low standing within the cult and were assigned with the relatively mundane duty of guarding guarding the C-B3 cortosis battle droid factory on Metalorn. Vinoc died alongside his brother in a lightsaber duel with Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="TNDA" />

==History==
===Origins===
[[File:Tann_body.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sev'rance Tann, one of Darth Tyranus' earliest recruits.]]
{{Quote|I'm offering you an opportunity - join me or die!|Darth Tyranus|<ref name="Trackdown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown]]''</ref>}}
One of the earliest recruits into what would become the Dark Acolyte was [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]], Tann was a tactical genius brought to Republic space together with her lover, [[Vandalor]], by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and trained by his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]]. Her skills and high level of success won her a great deal of favor from both [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]], as well as numerous other Confederate [[Separatist Council/Legends|figureheads]]. During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], Tann was charged with clearing out Tyranus' escape route during the fighting. While her actions allowed the Dark Lord to flee the carnage and facilitate the Clone Wars, it is generally assumed that the battle may have gone differently if the Dark Acolyte were allowed to lead the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|separatist droid forces]], as opposed to the support role she performed.<ref name="OSWFF116" /><ref name="GBcc" /><ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The Battle of Geonosis also saw the deployment of the Dark Acolyte trio, three anonymous members of the organization who piloted [[Sith Enforcer]] battle tanks. They guarded the ground-level entrance to [[Dooku's hangar/Legends|Tyranus' hangar]], and successfully delayed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] long enough for the Dark Lord to make his escape, though all three perished in the fighting.<ref name="TCWvg" />

After meeting with Darth Sidious on Coruscant following the Battle of Geonosis, Darth Tyranus traveled to his stronghold on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], where he was ambushed by Jedi Masters [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] and [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], who had managed to discover the fortress. Tyranus fended off both assailants, subduing Bulq with a blast of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] while burying a stubborn Tholme beneath a pile of rubble. While Tholme sought for a way to escape, Tyranus levitated Bulq's unconscious body away and treated his injuries. Reasoning with the Jedi swordmaster, Tyranus made Bulq acknowledge the anger within himself, and turned him to the dark side. Tasked by the Dark Lord with infiltrating the Jedi Order, the Weequay rescued Tholme and returned to the Jedi Temple as a hero, using this newfound credibility in an attempt to divide the Jedi from within.<ref name="Trackdown" />

After the Battle of Geonosis, a number of Jedi failed to report to Coruscant for assignment. [[Tol Skorr]], for one, was shot down by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] above [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] while on a mission, but was saved by Tyranus. Skorr gratefully followed Tyranus' lead without question ever since, including into the Confederate camp. Little is known of the circumstances behind the Jedi [[Kadrian Sey]]'s defection, she simply failed to report in and reappeared within Tyranus' cadre of Dark Acolytes.<ref name="J:CD" />

Approximately two months into the war, Darth Tyranus traveled to [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] looking to recruit. While surveying the battle within the local gladiatorial arena known as [[The Cauldron]], Tyranus' [[Unidentified henchman (the Cauldron)|host]] was swiftly dispatched and replaced by the cloaked figure of Asajj Ventress. The Dark Lord complimented her skills with Force concealment, though he stated that he hadn't come looking for a spy. Ventress leapt into the Cauldron and displayed her combat prowess against the myriad of gladiators, killing all. Tyranus was impressed by the display, but Ventress then overstepped her bounds when she declared herself a Sith. The amused Dark Lord levitated down to the arena floor and stated that while she fought like a Sith and displayed their trappings, she was still awash in fear, a trait that a true Sith lacked. Ventress moved to attack Tyranus, but the latter subdued her with a blast of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Ventress awoke within a large penthouse loft carved out of the local rock formations, presumably Tyranus' residence on Rattatak. She was swiftly attacked by the Dark Lord just after locating her lightsabers, and the two fought back and forth across the chamber. While Ventress impressed Darth Tyranus and Darth Sidious, observing via holocom, with her lightsaber skills, she was ultimately subdued, her lightsabers destroyed. Expecting execution, she was instead recruited into the CIS' military, and given a pair of [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|curved-hilt lightsabers]] to replace her Jedi weapons. Darth Sidious also gave her the standing order to find and eliminate the Jedi Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="CWC7" /><ref name="CWC6">{{CW|6}}</ref> Darth Tyranus also approached the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] Nikkos Tyris and his [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] followers on [[Susevfi]], promising the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] access to a Sith holocron in his possession in exchange for his services.<ref name="OSWFF116" />

===Emerging from the shadows===
{{Quote|We Jedi are tainted by our connections to the Republic. Many see us as its enforcers. We're on the wrong side. We should be helping to bring the Republic down, once and for all.|Sora Bulq|<ref name="No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>}}
After the Battle of Geonosis, the droid armies were vastly reduced, as many of their transports weren't able to escape the planet. To recover, Darth Tyranus had Sev'rance Tann emerge from the sidelines and coordinate a number of military campaigns to either acquire the necessary resources, or stall the Republic's battalions. Tann first took control of the [[Kaer Orbital Platform]], an abandoned [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] installation that contained a wealth of raw materials. While battling against the Republic forces led by Jedi Knight [[Jor Drakas]], Tann had a considerable number of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] constructed on-site. Once she attained an adequate number of troops, she retreated. Most of the army was sent to [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] for eventual use in the [[Assault on Sarapin|invasion]] and [[Recapture of Sarapin|subsequent defense]] of [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin]], while Tann traveled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to meet with [[Boorka]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a representative of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. In exchange for the destruction of the local Republic forces, Boorka provided information on a Republic superweapon; the [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]].<ref name="GBcc" />

Sev'rance Tann attacked the [[Decimator Facility|Decimator research and development facilities]] on [[Eredenn Prime]], capturing the complexes and a number of the weapons themselves, though she lacked the control codes to operate them. Tann subsequently attacked the research facility on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], defeating the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] forces defending the installation and obtained the codes. Fighting her way through the defenses of [[Asteroid 426]] to neutralize the defense grid protecting Sarapin, Tann headed the invasion of the world, utilizing the Decimators to great effect. Jedi Knight Jor Drakas was one of the casualties of the Separatist invasion, slain in single combat with Tann. Sarapin would later be recaptured by Jedi Master [[Echuu Shen-Jon]], who would become Tann's personal nemesis. Shen-Jon eventually tracked Tann to [[Krant]], and the two fought to the death. Sev'rance Tann was defeated, though unrepentant, taunting Shen-Jon with her dying breath and confident in the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|eventual defeat of the Jedi Order]].<ref name="GBcc" />

[[File:SWREP52-FC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Asajj Ventress and Durge, her frequent partner, on Ohma-D'un.]]
Another Acolyte, Asajj Ventress, was given control of the [[Separatist Queyta base|bioweapon laboratory]] on [[Queyta]], where the aerosol nicknamed "[[Swamp gas]]" was developed. Ventress planned on releasing this deadly weapon into the atmosphere of the Republic world [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], but she needed to test it's effectiveness first, and unleashed it on the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] colony on Naboo's moon, [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. Released by a contingent of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] rigged with aerosol sprayers, the bioweapon proved highly effective, and most of the Gungan colonists died within seconds of exposure. She and the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] led the Confederate forces on Ohma-D'un; Ventress planning on using the disgruntled [[Spice/Legends|Spice]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]] on the moon as scapegoats by releasing the gas into Naboo's atmosphere with their transports.<ref name="SWR51" />

A Jedi investigation team composed of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Glaive (Jedi)|Glaive]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Zule Xiss]] arrived on the moon at the request of Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] to investigate the sudden loss of contact with the Gungan colony. Durge engaged the intruders, and had little difficulty dealing with the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] accompanying the Jedi, though the Knights themselves provided some difficulty, and he called for reinforcements. While Skywalker and the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]] broke off to free the captive spice miners, Ventress quietly infiltrated the battlefield and decapitated Glaive. After an initial bout with Kenobi, she dismissed Durge to oversee the attack on Naboo while she dealt with the Jedi, using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] to reanimate a number of Gungan corpses to act as her reinforcements. Ventress almost defeated the Jedi, cleaving off Zule Xiss' arm, but was forced to break off when Skywalker and Alpha-17 returned. The attack on Naboo was a failure, with the Swamp gas transports destroyed, and the Confederate forces routed. However, while Durge felt that Tyranus would view this mission as a failure, Ventress was satisfied with the turn of events, having confronted and come to know her enemies.<ref name="SWR52">[[Republic 52|''Republic'' 52]]</ref>

===Failed Schism===
{{Main|Mission to Ruul (Clone Wars)}}
{{Quote|The ''plan'' was to ''lure'' you and the others here, kill one or two, and then blame ''you'' for the deaths. The schism would widen, and many more would join ''us''.|Sora Bulq to Mace Windu|<ref name="J:MW" />}}
Using his credibility gained from rescuing Tholme after [[Mission to Bakura (Clone Wars)|their duel with Dooku]], Sora Bulq began executing a plan to create a schism within the Jedi Order. Bulq retreated to [[Bulq family|his family]] estate on [[Ruul (moon)|Ruul]], and sent invitations to various leaders of dissident Jedi who refused to join the Republic war effort. He was joined by [[Sian Jeisel]], [[K'Kruhk]], Rhad Tarn, and his former padawan [[Mira (Near-Human)|Mira]]. In addition to the dissenters, Bulq invited a [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] member to attend, specifically requesting Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. When Windu arrived, Bulq greeted him personally, and claimed that while he was saddened by the loss of so many Jedi at Geonosis, he remained impartial as to the debate of whether or not to join the Republic. However, Bulq gave himself away during the meeting when he quietly sided with the radical Rhad Tarn, who advocated joining the Confederacy to bring down the corrupt Republic.<ref name="J:MW" />

[[File:BvV.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The mock duel between Asajj Ventress and Sora Bulq.]]

After the meeting, Bulq left the main group, ostensibly for a quiet walk about the estate. However, he instead rendezvoused with Asajj Ventress, and the two engaged in a mock lightsaber duel designed to appear as an assassination attempt. When the other Jedi arrived, the Dathomirian [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] killed Mira before breaking off, claiming to be operating on Mace Windu's orders. Windu searched about the grounds for Ventress' ship, an enraged and suspicious Rhad Tarn shadowing him. Windu found Ventress' landing site, and realized Sora Bulq's treachery; the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] host had established earlier that no ship could land on Ruul without his knowledge. While Windu left to confront Bulq, Tarn happened upon the landing site and was attacked by Ventress. Ruthlessly [[Dun Möch/Legends|taunted and toyed with]], Tarn fell to the dark side, and accepted Ventress' offer to join her. When K'Kruhk and Jeisel came to investigate, they now had two [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] to contend with.<ref name="J:MW" />

Mace Windu found Sora Bulq within the main house of the estate, mourning over Mira's body. Confronted by Windu over his turn to the dark side, Bulq revealed that his study of the dangerous [[Form VII/Legends|Vaapad lightsaber form]] had left him fascinated by it, and he had been quietly dabbling in it for years, before being turned by Tyranus. Windu's revelation forced Bulq to change his plans; instead of making Windu look the aggressor against the dissidents to start a schism, Bulq would kill Windu and the other Jedi and pin the murders on the dead Windu. Both duelists drew their lightsabers and engaged one another. As they battled, they sensed the disturbance caused by the other Jedi's duel with Ventress, so Windu broke off to go rescue them, subduing Bulq with a Force push. Rhad Tarn was cut down by Jeisel, though K'Kruhk didn't fare nearly so well, and was only saved by Windu's timely intervention. Ventress fought back against Windu, but was unable to compete with the Jedi [[Swordmaster]], and fled. Windu, K'Kruhk and Jeisel fled Ruul soon after, attacked by Sora Bulq's droids.<ref name="J:MW" />

===Destruction of the Queyta bioweapon facility===
{{Main|Mission to Queyta}}

Asajj Ventress would serve in many capacities during the war, but the repercussions of her first mission to Ohma-D'un would remain a focus of the Republic for some time. The Jedi began to devote many of their resources towards tracking down the source of the "[[Swamp gas]]" bioweapon. Ventress and Durge got wind of this development, and holed themselves up in the laboratory on Queyta. The installation itself was kept minimally staffed to avoid infiltration, and was precariously positioned on a massive rock formation that drifted along one of the many lava rivers of Queyta, ensuring continual mobility. Their primary objective was to secure the samples of antidote to the bioweapon to prevent them from falling into Republic hands. As they prepared to leave, and scuttle the facility, a Jedi strike team composed of Jedi Knights [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Knol Ven'nari]], [[Nico Diath]], [[Jon Antilles]], and [[Fay]] arrived.<ref name="SWR53" />

[[File:Ventress_quetya.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Asajj Ventress on Queyta.]]

While Ventress singled out Kenobi, Durge went to create a distraction, firing upon three of the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] members of the facilities staff and detonating their [[Pressure suit/Legends|Methane-filled pressure suits]]. The resulting firebomb incinerated the main lab and cracked through the rock foundation, allowing lava to break through, as well as killing Knol Ven'nari. Ventress and Durge escaped in the resulting chaos while the Jedi broke off to assess their losses. The Jedi pursued Ventress and Durge as they moved to escape the doomed complex. Ventress was attacked by Kenobi on a narrow catwalk, but she escaped by cutting apart the platform with her lightsabers, only to be confronted by Jon Antilles. However, Durge intervened and killed Antilles, and Ventress covered their escape by cutting apart overhead pipes conveying lava, raining fire on the Jedi and killing Nico Diath. Only Kenobi and Fay were left, and Fay managed to disable Ventress with a telekinetic assault, impaling the Dark Jedi with small shards of metal and glass. The prone Ventress was then [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]] attacked by Fay, and was rendered unconscious when she attempted to retaliate.<ref name="SWR53" />

Kenobi and Fay took a sample of the Swamp gas antidote from Ventress' inert form, but their escape was cut off by Durge. While the Jedi managed to fend off Durge, Ventress regained consciousness and impaled Fay with her lightsabers. Kenobi was hanging off the edge of the facility above the lava river below when Ventress found him. She revealed that Tyranus had left standing orders that he be taken alive, as the Dark Lord had plans for him, and offered to save his life. Kenobi refused, and Ventress declared that the next time they met, she would kill him, regardless of Tyranus' instructions, beginning her intense obsession with the Jedi. Ventress and Durge escaped in an [[Evac ship/Legends|evac ship]].<ref name="SWR53" />

===Duel on Yavin IV===
{{Quote|I'm going to make you pay for what you've done.''"<br />"''Come, Padawan. Your fall will be my ascension to the Sith.|Anakin Skywalker and Asajj Ventress|audio=ImGoingToMakeYouPay.flac|<ref name="CWC17">{{CW|17}}</ref>}}
[[File:Anakin_vs_asajj.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress duels Anakin Skywalker on Yavin IV.]]
Acting on her standing orders from Darth Sidious to find and kill [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Asajj Ventress travelled to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], where Skywalker was leading the Republic space forces during [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|the battle there]]. Entering the space battle aboard a Geonosian fanblade, Ventress shot down Blue Squadron to get Skywalker's attention.<ref name="CWC10">{{CW|10}}</ref> The two Force-wielders engaged in a vicious dogfight, with Ventress baiting Skywalker before fleeing into hyperspace. Skywalker pursued her to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], landing on the jungle world and searching the jungle, aided by a squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] sent by Obi-Wan Kenobi to assist him. As Skywalker and his troops swept the jungle searching for her, Ventress covertly attacked them, killing them off one by one with her telekinetic abilities. She then destroyed both [[Azure Angel|Skywalker's fighter]] and the Republic troop transport before confronting Skywalker directly.<ref name="CWC10" /><ref name="CWC11">{{CW|11}}</ref><ref name="CWC17" />

Their duel tore through the jungle undergrowth, Ventress using every weapon in her arsenal to attack Skywalker, reinforcing her lightsaber skills with telekinetic attacks. However, Skywalker responded in kind, and managed to disarm Ventress with clever swordplay, though Ventress simply retreated into the jungle canopy, retrieving her lightsabers with the Force. Skywalker pursued her into the tree tops, where Ventress led him on a wild chase, punctuated by sudden bursts of combat. Eventually, their duel took them to one of the ruined [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] [[Sith temple/Legends|temples]] that dotted the planet. Ventress managed to get the better of Skywalker, attacking him with dislodged chunks of masonry before blasting him off the elevated platform she occupied. After a brief pause, during which it began to rain, Skywalker attacked, assailing Ventress' position and driving her off the platform. Ventress retreated to the interior of one of the temples, Skywalker in close pursuit. Their battle took them to the upper levels of the structure, and back outside, where they fought their way up the rain-slicked ledges and stairways of the temple exterior towards the crumbling rooftop. On the rooftop, their battle continued with increasing ferocity until Ventress managed to disarm Skywalker. Skywalker responded by seizing her wrists, and crushing the one grasped in his [[Mechno-arm/Legends|prosthetic hand]], which caused Ventress to drop one of her dual lightsabers. Skywalker took up the lightsaber and attacked again, pushing Ventress to the edge of the roof before driving her to her knees. Drawing on his rage, Skywalker hammered her repeatedly with power blows until the stone of the rooftop crumbled, and Ventress fell off the structure into a gorge beneath.<ref name="CWC18">{{CW|18}}</ref><ref name="CWC19">{{CW|19}}</ref>

===Ventress introduced to Grievous===
{{Main|Mission to Trenchant space station}}
{{Quote|Who ''are'' you!?! Who are you!?!''"<br />"''Who am I? I am the ''future''.|Ventress, in her first meeting with General Grievous|<ref name="RoguesGallery">{{CWACite|3|Rogue's Gallery}}</ref>}}
Despite Asajj Ventress' repeated failures, she managed to retain Tyranus' favor. However, the Dark Lord desired to gauge her effectiveness against his newly emerged primary enforcer, the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], and sent her and Durge to the [[Space Station Trenchant/Legends|Space Station Trenchant]], his personal retreat. Ventress and Durge were told that the security sensors had alerted Tyranus to an intruder aboard, and ordered them to find him. They combed through the station, finding nothing, eventually reaching the trophy room. It was there that Grievous attacked them.<ref name="RoguesGallery" />

[[File:GrievousVentress_RG.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Asajj Ventress is overpowered by Grievous.]]

Durge was assaulted first, thrown across the room to Ventress' feet, though she failed to spot the attacker. When she leapt atop one of the trophy displays for a better vantage point, Grievous surprised her with an electrostaff, knocking her off the display. Ventress was caught by Durge, and the two got their first good look at Grievous. In the ensuing melee, Grievous managed to throw Ventress aside, but was distracted by Durge long enough for the Acolyte to recover and land a devastating blow across his metal back. Grievous brandished his own lightsabers and disabled Durge, but was driven back by Ventress' attack. Ventress managed to disarm Grievous, though the cyborg retaliated in brutal fashion and throttled her into unconsciousness.<ref name="RoguesGallery" />

Tyranus prevented Grievous from finishing off Ventress and Durge, feeling that their usefulness had not yet run it's course. Ventress and Durge eventually recovered, though Grievous was dubbed the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]] for his accomplishment. This first meeting between Ventress and Grievous set the stage for a poor working relationship in the future, one that consisted primarily of heated rivalry and intense hatred,<ref name="Fan Days Script">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091103fd/index.html|text=Fan Days Script: A Prelude to "Point Rain"}}</ref> although the two did share rare moments of cordiality.<ref name="ARCtroopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>

===The Cestus Deception===
{{Main|Mission to Ord Cestus}}

{{Dialogue|Obi-Wan Kenobi|Then your [[JK-13 security droid|droid]] order was a sham?|Ventress|Intended to frighten [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and your precious [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] into an overreaction. I would say our plan worked, wouldn't you? The resulting slaughter will tip [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in our favor. Then once we do [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] the [[Dashta eel|tissue]], who needs [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Cestus]]?|Kit Fisto|You're a monster.|attr=Ventress reveals the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]' plans for [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] to Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]|src=<ref name="TCD" />}}

Just after the Clone Wars began, the [[Cestus Cybernetics]] workshops on [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] produced a new type of security droid; the [[JK-13 security droid|JK-13 Bio-droid]]. The JKs, colloquially termed the "Jedi Killers" for their effectiveness even against Jedi, were ideal Battle droids in almost every way, save for the fact that the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dashta eel]] that was used in the machine's processor was native only to the [[Dashta Mountains]] on Ord Cestus. As Confederate scientists were still having difficulty cloning the eel, mass production of the JK-13s for battlefield use was not an option. However, due to Cestus' financial situation, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] planned on manipulating events to drive the planet into the Separatist fold, before allowing the Republic to conquer it to prevent the JKs from getting into their hands, and acting as an example to push other worlds into the CIS. Darth Tyranus dispatched Asajj Ventress to execute this scheme.<ref name="TCD" />

[[File:VentressTCD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress during her mission to Ord Cestus.]]

She landed in the Ord Cestus wilderness, planting a powerful Force-field to protect her ship before departing with the [[X'Ting]] [[Fizzik]] to meet with the local crime lord [[Trillot]]. Presenting salt, water, and two [[Windsnake]]s as ingredients for a X'Ting ritual feast to open negotiations, before inquiring as to why she hadn't been taken to meet the [[Five Families of Cestus Cybernetics|Five Families]] who controlled Cestus Cybernetics yet. She learned that a Jedi had been sent to negotiate with the corporation on behalf of the Republic; Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi. Ventress opted to deal with Kenobi before she met with the Five Families, telling Trillot to keep her presence on Ord Cestus and identity secret. She spent several days watching and waiting, also shadowing Kenobi during a formal X'Ting mask ball while he danced with [[G'Mai Duris]], the political leader of Ord Cestus, and a puppet of Cestus Cybernetics. Ventress' knowledge of the Sith Quey'Tek meditation allowed her to evade Kenobi's notice. Ventress also eavesdropped on Kenobi's meeting with Trillot, telling the crime lord to be help Kenobi for the time being to gain his trust, before shadowing Kenobi to the [[Cleft Head]] cantina and listening in his secret meeting with G'Mai Duris.<ref name="TCD" />

To make the Five Families more willing to deal with the Republic, Kenobi and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] initiated a false assassination attempt on them. Fisto, masquerading as Dark Acolyte and calling himself "Nemonus," hijacked the private railcar the Five Families used to travel about the planet and threatened them, claiming that the Families' attempt to renegotiate had eroded Tyranus' faith in them. Before "Nemonus" could kill them, Kenobi intervened, and apparently drove him and his forces off. Ventress provided a recording of the entire incident to G'Mai Duris, revealing that the assassination attempt was a sham, and forcing Kenobi to leave Ord Cestus in disgrace. However, Ventress fully expected Kenobi to make a return appearance, and remained ready.<ref name="TCD" />

Kenobi joined with Fisto out in the Cestus wilds, where the Jedi and his squad of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Troopers]] had been training the local revolutionary force, [[Desert Wind]], in advanced guerrilla warfare tactics. The Ord Cestus industrial complex was attacked on all fronts by this force, resulting in chaos. Into this Asajj Ventress stepped, approaching G'Mai Duris as Darth Tyranus' representative, and offering aid against the Desert Wind incursions. Using her Force abilities to pinpoint the location of Kenobi and Fisto's base, Ventress gave the data to Duris and the Five Families, who sent a cadre of JK-13 droids to the site. The Desert Wind was scattered, most of the members captured by the droids. Now in desperation, Kenobi and Fisto decided to attempt to break into the Five Families' production facility and shut down the lines, while the Desert Wind remnants, led by the ARC troopers, would provide the coordinates of the power and water filtration plants of Ord Cestus to be destroyed by a bombardment from the recently arrived Republic fleet. Ventress countered by recalibrating the coordinates so that the bombardment would hit a cave fault, destroying an entire industrial complex and it's millions of workers, and intercepting Kenobi and Fisto as they traveled through secret underground tunnels to the production facility. The Jedi were trapped within an energy field within an underground grotto, while Ventress gloated over them. Ventress herself admitted that she was acting under standing orders from Tyranus to bring Kenobi to him alive, though he also admitted that she would like nothing better than to fight him to the death.<ref name="TCD" />

The Separatist plot would have succeeded were it not for one of the ARC troopers, [[Jangotat]], who sent in new coordinates for the Republic bombardment, instead firing on the Five Families' bunker, killing him in the process. The resulting power surge caused the energy shields containing Kenobi and Fisto in the grotto to momentarily short out, allowing them to escape. Ventress first set her personal cadre of X'Ting warriors against them to observe and gauge their fighting forms, before attacking Fisto. The lightsaber duel between Asajj Ventress and Kit Fisto was fast and furious, but Ventress managed to pierce his guard after landing a kick to his jaw. While Fisto fell into water of the grotto, Kenobi attacked Ventress. Both duelists fell into the grotto when Fisto cut apart the loading dock they fought on before passing out. Ventress was forced to flee from Kenobi's relentless determination, as he demonstrated a willingness to die to bring her down. With the Five Families dead, and all of Ventress' manipulations laid bare, the Cestus deception was a failure.<ref name="TCD" />

===Capture and Escape of Obi-Wan Kenobi===
{{Main|Escape from Rattatak}}

[[File:Alphatorture.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress torturing Alpha-17, who was captured along with Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]

During the [[Battle of Jabiim]], Obi-Wan Kenobi and the ARC trooper Alpha-17 were seemingly killed when they were caught inside an exploding [[Walker/Legends|Walker]], but they were actually captured by Asajj Ventress. Ventress took them to her homeworld of Rattatak and imprisoned them within the dungeons of [[Castle Ventress|her fortress]]. The Dark Jedi infected Kenobi's body with [[Muscle maggot]]s to drain his strength, while using a [[Sith torture mask]] to obscure his connection to the Force and prevent him from escaping, all in an attempt to break him and demonstrate his uselessness to Tyranus.<ref name="SWR59">[[Republic 59|''Republic'' 59]]</ref> For Alpha-17, Ventress relied on more conventional interrogation techniques. Ultimately, Kenobi managed to escape Ventress despite her safeguards by breaking the water pipes he was suspended from, freeing himself and Alpha-17. They broke out of their cells and led a prisoner revolt, making their way to the landing platforms with the aid of Ventress' old enemy, [[Osika Kirske/Legends|Osika Kirske]], and stealing [[Ky Narec/Legends|Ky Narec's]] lightsaber along the way. Ventress managed to catch up with them at the landing platform, killing Kirske and dueling Kenobi. As she fought Kenobi, who wielded Narec's lightsaber alongside his own, Alpha-17 hijacked Ventress' [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|Ginivex fanblade]] and retrieved Kenobi. While enraged over Kenobi's escape, Ventress was left despondent over the theft of Ky Narec's lightsaber.<ref name="SWR60" />

===Quinlan Vos' infiltration===
{{Main|Tibrin revolution}}
{{Quote|I've known the truth about you from the start, Quinlan Vos. This was Tholme's plan, no doubt. He always did think himself more clever than he really is. Always prepared to sacrifice pawns like you.|Darth Tyranus|<ref name="J:CD" />}}
As the Clone Wars picked up, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] proposed a bold scheme; dispatch Quinlan Vos to infiltrate the Dark Acolytes and provide intelligence on Darth Tyranus' plans. Only Mace Windu was made aware of this plan, the rest of the Republic forces being left to believe that Vos was a traitor. Quinlan was accepted into the Separatist ranks, though he was delegated to being a simple errand boy, due to Tyranus' lack of trust in him. Frustrated by the mundane tasks he was being set to, the undercover Jedi Master traveled to [[Antar/Legends|Antar]] to confront the Dark Lord about this. Arriving at the entrance to Tyranus' stronghold, Vos was confronted by Tol Skorr and Kadrian Sey. Perceiving him as a threat, the two drew their lightsabers and attacked him. Vos easily held them off, though the scuffle alerted Sora Bulq, who intervened. Bulq escorted Vos to meet with Tyranus. Vos presented his case that he was being wasted on mundane tasks while "lesser skilled Jedi" performed the important jobs. Tyranus countered that the other acolytes had earned his trust, unlike Vos, though he agreed to give him a chance. Tyranus first demanded that Quinlan's abilities and skill sets be evaluated, and sharpened if need be. As Vos left the chamber, Sora Bulq counseled that Vos' inherent darkness made him potentially useful.<ref name="J:CD" />

[[File:Quin_Dooku.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Quinlan Vos and Darth Tyranus]]

Vos was provided with a number of lessons in the dark side of the Force, all the while using his psychometric abilities to gather intelligence, learning of Tyranus' negotiations with the [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]] Guardians. During a sparring match with Tyranus, Vos' fighting skills were heavily criticized by Tyranus, who gave him a sound beating. Immediately afterwards, the Dark Lord traveled to [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]], which had just been captured by the Confederacy. Accompanied by Vos, Sora Bulq, Tol Skorr, and Kadrian Sey, Tyranus negotiated with the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictator]], [[Suribran Tu]]. Tu was compliant, though Tyranus turned to his acolytes for council on what to do with him. Kadrian Sey recommended keeping him in power to ensure administrative continuity, while Quinlan Vos called for his removal, questioning his trustworthiness and citing that leaving a tyrant in power only demonstrated a lack of meaningful difference between the Republic and the Confederacy. After pressing Vos for his reasons, Tyranus opted for his argument, and decapitated Suribran Tu on the spot. Sora Bulq was given control of the local government, Skorr and Sey were tasked with clearing away Tu's body and placing his head on display for the local populace. Quinlan Vos was given a completely different task; intercept the duplicitous Falleen Senator [[Zurros]] at [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] and assassinate him.<ref name="J:CD" />

Over the course of the six days that Quinlan Vos was off-planet, another Jedi infiltrator, [[Shylar]], was found out and captured. Taken to the dungeon level of a stronghold, she was mercilessly tortured by Kadrian Sey while Darth Tyranus quietly interrogated her. Vos entered the dungeon, supposedly with Zurros' head, but only with his topknot. Vos revealed that he had only intimidated Zurros rather than killing him, stating that Tyranus would only have to start over with Zurros' replacement, where the Senator now knew what would happen if he failed again. Tyranus was apparently pleased with Vos' actions, valuing intelligence. The Dark Lord then told the undercover Jedi Master about his negotiations with the Kiffu guardians, planning to establish a Confederate base on the prison planet Kiffex, but experiencing resistance from [[Sheyf]] [[Tinté Vos|Tinte Vos]]. Tyranus wanted Quinlan to accompany him.<ref name="J:CD" />

===Subjugation of the Kiffu Guardians===
{{Main|Duel on Kiffu}}
{{Quote|You are a stupid old woman, Tinté. You have no idea who or what you are dealing with. You will now learn!|Darth Tyranus|<ref name="J:CD" />}}
[[File:Duel_on_Kiffu.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tyranus leads the Dark Acolytes against the Kiffu Guardians.]]
Arriving on Kiffu with Quinlan Vos, Tol Skorr, and Kadrian Sey in his entourage, Darth Tyranus negotiated with Sheyf Tinté Vos. The proceedings quickly soured when Sheyf Vos revealed her intent to use the post-war confusion when the Clone Wars ended to gather power for herself. Tyranus ordered his underlings to attack her guards and assassinate her. The battle was already slanted in favor of the Dark Acolytes when the Dark Lord decided to demonstrate his power, blasting numerous members of the Sheyf's guard with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. The acolytes began competing with one another to reach the Sheyf first. Quinlan Vos overlapped the competition and seized his aunt, lightsaber raised, only to turn and cut down Kadrian Sey when she moved to attack. Revealed as a Republic agent, Quinlan Vos grabbed hold of Tinté and fled the scene. Tyranus ordered Skorr to finish mopping up the remaining guards while he quietly pursued Vos.<ref name="J:CD" />

Within the Guardian complex, Quinlan Vos attempted to convince his confused and enraged aunt to gather the Kiffu clans to resist Tyranus, but was interrupted by the Dark Lord himself. Tyranus revealed that he had known all along that Vos was a Republic mole. As he and Vos crossed blades, Tyranus deduced the infiltration to be Tholme's plan, and explained that he wanted Vos to continue serving as a spy, but serving the Sith instead of the Jedi. Vos refused, and Tyranus subdued him with the Force before telling him to ask Tinté the truth about his parents' death. Tyranus further pressed Vos to augment his psychometric abilities with the dark side of the Force and literally read the information from his aunt. Quinlan Vos learned that Tinté Vos had sacrificed his parents to [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] as part of a deal. Returning the enraged Vos' lightsaber to him, Tyranus encouraged him to strike down Tinté, and Vos complied.<ref name="J:CD" />

Now certain that Quinlan Vos' conversion to the dark side was no longer an act, Darth Tyranus took him under his wing and accepted him fully into the Dark Acolytes' fold.<ref name="J:CD" />

===Rise of the Cortosis Battle Droids===
{{Main|Rise of the Cortosis Battle Droids|Mission to Tatooine (Anakin Skywalker)|Coruscant/Legends Insurrection|Mission to Metalorn (Clone Wars)}}

[[File:Saato_vs_Anakin.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Anakin Skywalker duels Saato on Tatooine.]]
One of the Confederate constituents, [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], began mining [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis ore]] and using it to create new model of [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] with upgraded armor, increasing their battlefield effectiveness and even allowing them to compete with Jedi. These droids were deployed in very limited numbers on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], led by the Dark Acolyte [[Saato]] and the Force-sensitive [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. The Republic managed to get word of the attack, and Anakin Skywalker was sent to investigate. As he conducted his investigation, he battled with several of the cortosis droids before being led to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], where he was confronted by Sing and Saato. Sing was subdued, though Saato choked the Jedi into unconsciousness with [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] and imprisoned him in the palace dungeons. Skywalker broke out of the dungeons, freeing many of the other prisoners before fleeing the scene aboard a skiff. Saato pursued him to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] and shot him down. The two dueled next to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]], but Saato was defeated and killed.<ref name="TNDA" />

While Skywalker did report the events on Tatooine to his superiors, it was too late to prevent Tyranus' attack. The Dark Lord personally led the Confederate forces in a surprise raid on Coruscant itself, accompanied by the Acolyte [[Trenox]], and reinforced by a cadre of cortosis battle droids. Skywalker and Trenox encountered one another during the battle, but Trenox fled into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. Linking up with Tyranus, Trenox joined the assault on the Jedi Temple, breaching the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. Trenox was again confronted by Skywalker, though this time opted to hold his ground, and paid for it with his life. He was, however, successful in delaying Skywalker long enough for Tyranus to steal at least one [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] and escape.<ref name="TNDA" />

[[File:Dookuclone.png|thumb|right|150px|One of the Tyranus replicas being slain by Anakin Skywalker.]]

The battlefield effectiveness of the cortosis battle droids was deemed too great by Darth Sidious, who was worried it might upset the continuous stalemate he was creating. In his alter ego of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, he allowed information of the cortosis [[Droid factory (disambiguation)|Droid factory]] on Metalorn to be leaked to the Republic, and Anakin Skywalker was dispatched to destroy the factory. He confronted [[Karoc]] and [[Vinoc]], who guarded the facilities power core and cut them down. Skywalker even managed to capture Wat Tambor, though he was confronted by one of the [[Doppelgänger of Dooku|doppelgängers of Tyranus]] as he made his escape. Their duel was largely evenly matched, until the false Count began [[Dun Möch/Legends|taunting]] Skywalker with knowledge of the Jedi's [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|dead mother]]. Skywalker cut down the Tyranus-replica in a rage, though the doppelgänger used his last breath to taunt Skywalker over his use of the dark side to defeat him.<ref name="TNDA" />

===The Retrieval of the Holocron of Heresies===
{{Quote|Clever, Skorr. Lie in wait, let me retrieve Darth Andeddu's holocron, then strike!|Quinlan Vos|<ref name="SWR63" />}}
Darth Tyranus eventually became aware of the location of the [[Holocron of Heresies]], though whether this was due to his own researches, or if he was informed by his master, Darth Sidious is unknown. Whatever the case, he traveled to Korriban with Quinlan Vos and Tol Skorr, dispatching them to retrieve it. The mission quickly became a competition between the two, with Skorr lying in wait for Vos to retrieve the Holocron, using the secret paths he discovered during his previous visit to get the drop on Vos. However, Vos countered by guiding a [[Tuk'ata/Legends|Tuk'ata]] Sith hound into the fray and effectively siccing it on Skorr, retaking the holocron in the confusion. Vos fled up a large shaft towards the roof of the Sith temples, with Skorr in close pursuit. Vos reached the ramp of the ship hovering above first, and kicked Skorr back down the shaft. Tol Skorr would have died then and there had Darth Tyranus not intervened, levitating Skorr back up to the ship with the Force.<ref name="SWR63" />

Tyranus voiced his disappointment in Skorr while the latter raged at Vos about the outcome of their contest, though Quinlan dismissed this, reasoning that the only thing that mattered was that their master had the holocron. Tyranus acknowledged that Quinlan Vos was rapidly becoming the most reliable of his lieutenants. Vos accompanied Tyranus to one of his strongholds as a guest, and even had the Holocron of Heresies displayed to him. Tyranus and Vos engaged in a brief discussion about the Sith, during which the former denied the rumors that he was a Sith Lord. Tyranus then presented Vos with a gift; [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|Darth Andeddu's synth-crystal]]. He also gave the Dark Acolyte another mission; to travel to Coruscant and perform an assassination.<ref name="SWR63" />

===The Assassination of Senator Viento===
{{Quote|I failed to protect Senator Viento. But I will not fail in bringing you back to answer for his death.|K'Kruhk to Quinlan Vos|<ref name="SWR63" />}}
[[File:BlankSlate3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Quinlan Vos scuffles with K'Kruhk after assassinating Senator Viento.]]
Quinlan Vos was provided with only a small amount of information, and was led to believe that the target was none other than the elusive Darth Sidious. Infiltrating a Senate gathering disguised as his dead uncle, he was given the target's identity by Darth Tyranus via communicator. Waiting until Senator [[Viento]] had returned home and went to sleep, Vos infiltrated his apartment, dodging the security systems and the notice of the target's bodyguard; Jedi Master K'Kruhk. As Vos moved to finish Viento, the ozone stench of his lightsaber alerted K'Kruhk to his presence. Vos was momentarily stalled by the Jedi's intervention, though he quickly cut down Viento, only to be shocked to discover his target's true identity. Vos moved to escape, with the Jedi in close pursuit. Khaleen Hentz was supposed to pick him up, but she was a no-show, and Quinlan was left to with K'Kruhk to contend with. Landing atop a cargo tram below the apartment, Quinlan and K'Kruhk scuffled before Vos blasted him aside with a Force push.<ref name="SWR63" />

Meeting Tyranus at the rendezvous point, he learned that Khaleen had been prevented from picking him up by Tol Skorr, acting on orders from their master. When he revealed to the Dark Lord that he mistook Viento for a Sith, Tyranus pointed that out as his mistake, and made clear that this was just a political assassination, and another test for Vos. Tyranus pointed out that while Quinlan had turned to the dark side, he had not yet embraced it, and he had disappointed him yet again. Darth Tyranus departed Coruscant with Tol Skorr.<ref name="SWR63" />

===Quinlan Vos' subsequent missions===
{{Main|Battle of Honoghr/Legends}}
{{Quote|&hellip;I am Quinlan Vos, a servant of Count Dooku. Unlike you, an obedient servant. As our master said, an example must be made.|Quinlan Vos|<ref name="SWR66">[[Republic 66|''Republic'' 66]]</ref>}}
[[File:KharisFennsDeath.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Quinlan Vos moves to execute Kh'aris Fenn.]]
Operating as the Dark Lord's envoy and executioner, Quinlan Vos was dispatched by Darth Tyranus to dispense with [[Kh'aris Fenn]]. Fenn had used credits allocated by Tyranus to facilitate a takeover of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to instead pursue a personal vendetta against the Jedi, hiring bounty hunters from the [[Crimson Nova]] guild. The Crimson Nova had been brought to heel by the Jedi, and Fenn's identity had been discovered. Vos, masquerading as [[Rh'ajah Fenn]], delivered Tyranus' message, and execution order. Revealing his identity, Vos handily subdued Fenn as he attempted to defend himself before igniting his lightsaber through the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek's]] chest. Vos decapitated Fenn's corpse, taking the head as proof of kill to Tyranus, and leaving a recording of the incident at the scene as a warning to others. The Jedi who happened upon the scene later were appalled by Vos' cruelty, and the obvious pleasure he took in the deed.<ref name="SWR66" />

Quinlan was later dispatched to [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] to retrieve the Scientific Instrument Package for the Separatist [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] [[Trihexalophine1138]], an aggressive defoliant that had been released on the lush world during a battle in orbit. He happened upon his former [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], and one of her surviving clone troopers, [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], being attacked by the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] natives as they moved to take the SIP for the Republic. He intervened and gunned down the Noghri, and offered to work with the Jedi. Despite initial tensions with Bly, they advanced quickly through the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] temple the Noghri had hidden the SIP within, evading the traps and overcoming the Noghri in their path. Guiding Secura and Bly to his escape ship, the [[Skorp-Ion]], Vos made his play, offering them safe-passage off-world in exchange for the SIP. Secura and Bly resisted, and Bly was quickly subdued while Vos crossed blades with his former student. Secura was eventually brought down, and Vos demanded she hand over the SIP. She refused, and Vos prepared to kill her, but hesitated. As he paused, he was fired at by Bly, who had recovered. Opting to retreat, Vos leapt aboard the Skorp-Ion and fled, without the SIP.<ref name="SWR68">[[Republic 68|''Republic'' 68]]</ref>

===Lure on Vjun===
{{Main|Battle of the Phindar Spaceport|Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)}}
[[File:Insider88b_art.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress would be Dooku's primary agent in luring Yoda to Vjun.]]

Darth Tyranus conceived of an ambitious plot to assassinate Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], luring his old mentor to [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] with an invitation to meet for peace-talks. The initial message was delivered by the Jedi [[Jai Maruk]], a spy who was intercepted and defeated by Asajj Ventress before being given the message by Tyranus and sent back to Coruscant. The Sith Lord sent a secondary message of his own with a holoprojector built into the damaged lightsaber taken from [[Jang Li-Li]] after the Dark Acolyte killed him. Ventress also began appealing to Dooku to make her his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|formal apprentice]], though Tyranus refused, citing her growing thirst for power would lead her to an eventual desire to betray him. He then tortured her through the Force and treated her as a lackey to humble her. While Tyranus' message to Yoda was intended as a lie, and a lure to assassination, Tyranus was having very real second thoughts about his allegiance to the Sith.<ref name="Y:DarkRendezvous" />

Darth Sidious discovered Yoda's plans to meet with Darth Tyranus on Vjun when the Jedi met with his alter-ego; Chancellor Palpatine; to explain his absence. Sidious told Tyranus to treat Yoda as "he deserves". Asajj Ventress was charged with intercepting and killing Yoda en route, but instead she captured the decoy [[Palleus Chuff]] above Ithorr. Chuff a famous actor who had made reputation for himself as a Yoda-impersonator. Ventress was provided with the location of the real Yoda by the droid agent [[Solis]], and traveled to the [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]] [[Phindar Spaceport|spaceport]] with a cadre of assassin droids in tow. She attacked the space station Yoda and his Jedi escort were aboard at the time, setting the assassin droids against the Jedi Jai Maruk and [[Maks Leem]]. The R2 unit droid casing Yoda had concealed himself within was pinned to the ground with prototype personal tractor beam projectors that the droids carried before being cut apart by Ventress. However, Yoda had cut a hole in the floor with his lightsaber escaped into the parking levels below. Ventress sent a team of the droids after him before turning on Jai Maruk, as she was denied his life the last time they fought by Tyranus.<ref name="Y:DarkRendezvous" />

Maruk fought hard against his attacker, but Ventress was simply a better duelist and prevailed, cutting him down. Maruk's padawan, [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]], attacked Ventress, though the Dark Acolyte easily held him off, and explained her motivations to him, tempting him with the dark side of the Force. She used an explosive dart to create a hull breach in the side of the station, using this to distract the surviving Padawans while she made her escape; she had killed Maruk, and Maks Leem had been killed by the droids. While Ventress fought Maruk, Yoda rescued Palleus Chuff and the two sabotaged Ventress' ship, forcing her to hijack a different ship to make her escape. Tyranus was ultimately displeased by the turn of events, though he remained committed to luring Yoda to Vjun. When Ventress made her report to her master, she suggested that Tyranus choose now to rebel against Sidious, assassinating him and assuming his place, as per the Sith way, with herself as his apprentice. Tyranus ordered Ventress to return to Vjun.<ref name="Y:DarkRendezvous" />

Ventress was posted in the sublevels of Tyranus' base in [[Château Malreaux]], guarding the entrances to secret passages into the system of caverns permeating the area, while Tyranus awaited Yoda in the study. When Yoda arrived, he and his old pupil began speaking, attempting to reason with and sway one another to his own cause, while Ventress intercepted the Padawans with Yoda, Whie Malreaux and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy|Tallisibeth "Scout" Enwandung-Esterhazy]], when they attempted to infiltrate the Chateau through the secret passages. Ventress would proceed to physically and psychologically torture the two, intent on turning the promising Whie Malreaux to the dark side. Tyranus used similar methods against Yoda, though Yoda remained stubbornly resistant to Tyranus' psychological tactics, and responded in kind. Ventress' attempt to turn Whie failed, though before Ventress could kill the Padawans, the droid Solis intervened, looking for payback after Ventress backed out on their earlier arrangement and refused to pay him.<ref name="Y:DarkRendezvous" />

It was then that Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived in the Chateau, looking to rescue Yoda. Ventress had managed to destroy Solis, but was wounded in the process, and decided to flee from the newly arrived Jedi. Tyranus, who had begun to crack and consider re-defecting back to the Jedi, was enraged by the arrival of the two, especially Skywalker, whom the Dark Lord viewed as his own "replacement" as the rising star of the Jedi Order. Tyranus attacked [[Whirry Malreaux]], the mad [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscountess]] and mother of Whie who lived in the Chateau, using the distraction to lash out at Yoda, scoring a hit along the Jedi's side. However, even with this early success, and even with the dark side aura that permeated Vjun reinforcing him, Tyranus was no match for Yoda, and retreated, using an orbital missile aimed at the Chateau to cover his escape.<ref name="Y:DarkRendezvous" />

===The Infiltration of the Jedi Order===
{{Main|Duel on the Titavian IV|Duel in the Coruscant Underlevels}}

[[File:SWREP69-FC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Quinlan Vos only survived Ventress and Skorr's pursuit with the aid of Obi-Wan Kenobi, allowing him to infiltrate the Jedi Order.]]

Darth Tyranus conceived of a plan to infiltrate the Jedi Order, dispatching Quinlan Vos to return to them, pretending to re-defect back to the Republic. For added credibility, he sent Asajj Ventress and Tol Skorr to retrieve him, intending them to fail but keeping them in the dark about the nature of the mission. Vos fled to the deserted science vessel, ''[[Titavian IV]]'', and sent a Jedi distress signal. He repaired his ship and was scrounging the ''Titavian'' for supplies when Ventress and Skorr found him. The call for aid was answered by Obi-Wan Kenobi, who boarded the ''Titavian'' and found Vos being harassed by Ventress' attack droids. Kenobi decided to aid his former friend, and helped Vos escape the droids. When Kenobi pressed him about his activities, Vos claimed that he was still a Republic agent in the enemy camp. As Kenobi and Vos searched through the ''Titavian'' they were again set upon by Ventress' droids, who herded them to Ventress and Skorr themselves.<ref name="TDOR" />

While Skorr attacked Vos, Ventress fixated on Kenobi. Skorr managed to subdue Vos, though Kenobi evaded Ventress and released a Rancor from its onboard holding pen, effectively siccing it on Ventress and Skorr. While they broke off to deal with it, Kenobi rescued Vos. Vos was sent out it Kenobi's one-man starfighter to retrieve his own ship, the ''[[Skorp-Ion]]'', while Kenobi delayed Ventress and Skorr. However, Kenobi was forced to contend with the Rancor as well, as Ventress managed to dominate it. Kenobi made it to the hangar, where he was attacked by Skorr aboard his own ship. Leaping atop Ventress Rancor mount, Kenobi kicked her off and killed the beast before retreating to an overhead catwalk. Ventress pursued him and attacked, but was forced to break off when Skorr fired on the platform. Unfortunately, Skorr was himself shot down by Vos aboard the ''Skorp-Ion'', allowing Kenobi and Vos to flee. However, Ventress had placed a tracer aboard Vos' ship, allowing her to track Vos. Despite this, the retrieval was a failure, and adding insult to injury, Ventress and Skorr were in turn retrieved by Grievous. Kenobi brought Vos before Master [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] just prior to the [[Battle of Rendili]], and Vos was disarmed and incarcerated. However, during the battle, power surges aboard the Republic flagship from the battle damage allowed Vos to escape and retrieve his weapons. Taking a Jedi starfighter, Vos joined the Republic forces. Vos' aid proved instrumental to the Republic victory.<ref name="TDOR" />

Afterwards, Quinlan Vos was brought before the Jedi Council for judgment, with Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Tholme testifying on his behalf. Quinlan Vos was accepted back into the Jedi Order.
