During the latter stage of the trial, Anakin Skywalker stole away to receive a message from [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], his secret wife. Asajj Ventress, who had arrived on-planet in pursuit of Vos and Kenobi, decided to attack him instead. Ventress declared that first she would kill Amidala to torture Skywalker, before killing him. Skywalker attacked her, and the two battled back and forth across the deserted Coruscant rooftop. Ventress managed to slash at Skywalker's face, leaving him with his distinctive facial scar next to his right eye, though she was subdued by Skywalker's brutal retaliation. Entangled in a mess of electrified wires, Ventress was dropped off the side of the building.<ref name="TDOR" /> Despite her injuries, Ventress would survive to fight another day. Kenobi would later visit the Coruscant underlevels beneath the site of the duel, and see the scavengers and slum-dwellers who missed limbs and sported lightsaber burns, victims of Ventress' escape.<ref name="Obsession">''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]''</ref>

===The Kidnapping of Rotta the Hutt===
{{Main|Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Teth/Legends|Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends}}

[[File:AnakinObiVentress-TheHiddenEnemy.png|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress squares off with Kenobi and Skywalker on Christophsis.]]
The Confederacy of Independent Systems began looking to gain control of all the hyperspace lanes to the Outer Rim, and were looking to deal with the Hutts to get them. However, they didn't trust [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to side with them, so Darth Sidious and Darth Tyranus began plotting with Jabba's uncle, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], to kidnap Jabba's son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta the Hutt]], to force his hand.<ref name="TCWf" /> On the off-chance that Jabba appealed to the Republic for help, Asajj Ventress was dispatched to delay the only two Jedi who would be available to help; Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi. Ventress took command of the Separatist forces on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], where Kenobi and Skywalker were leading the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Republic campaign]]. She enlisted the disgruntled [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone sergeant]], [[Slick/Legends|Slick]], as a Confederate agent, and he began supplying them with intel on the Republic's movements. When the Republic forces became aware of a spy in their midst, Kenobi and Skywalker traveled to the Confederacy's command center to attempt to discover his identity. However, while Slick was discovered by the Clones, he used the Jedi's absence to engage in a campaign of sabotage, destroying the Republic gunships and weapon depots. The Jedi confronted Ventress within the command center, though the duel was ultimately little more than a stalling tactic, and the Jedi learned too late the identity of the spy. They also beheld the arrival of Confederate reinforcements.<ref name="THE">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}</ref>

While the Jedi moved to lead their diminished forces against the Separatist reinforcements, Ventress departed for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], kidnapping Rotta personally. The Huttlet was taken and ensconced in a [[B'omarr Monastery|CIS-controlled B'omarr monastery]] on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], guarded by the Dark Acolyte and a large force of battle droids. When Republic forces led by Anakin Skywalker and his new Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], arrived, Ventress allowed them to gain entry into the monastery and retrieve the Huttlet, recording the event with a her personal spy droid, [[4A-7/Legends|4A-7]]. The droid then edited the footage to make the Jedi treatment of Rotta appear abusive before sending the recording to Darth Tyranus on Tatooine, who presented it to an infuriated Jabba the Hutt. Ventress called in droid reinforcements before moving to retrieve Rotta from the Jedi, pursuing Skywalker and Tano deeper into the monastery as they made their way to a secondary landing platform at the rear of the complex. She managed to head the Jedi off in an abandoned Hutt throne room - the monastery was formerly Hutt-controlled - before they fled into a Rancor pit below the chamber. As Ventress battled the Jedi, the [[Jungle rancor/Legends|Jungle rancor]] kept within the chamber attacked them, and Skywalker outmaneuvered her, and Ventress was nearly crushed under the beast's bulk. Escaping the beast, Ventress pursued the Jedi to the landing platform, left with only Tano to contend with while Skywalker attempted to break in a native [[Can-cell/Legends|Can-cell]]. Ahsoka didn't last long against Ventress' fury, and she only survived because Skywalker intervened with his new steed. Skywalker and Tano escaped to a nearby landing platform with a ship landed on it.<ref name="TCWf" />

[[File:AnakinVsDooku_Tatooine.png|thumb|left|250px|Tyranus attacks Skywalker out on the Tatooine dune sea.]]
Forced to rely on the Confederate air support to shoot down Skywalker, and allow Tyranus to twist the facts and make the Republic look responsible to Jabba, Ventress then went to deal with the newly arrived Kenobi. Luring Kenobi deeper within the monastery, Ventress engaged him. Kenobi simply fended off Ventress, all the while prodding and enraging her, and it wasn't until they reached the outer ramparts of the monastery that Ventress understood that Kenobi was simply stalling her, preventing her from taking direct command of the CIS forces and buying time for Skywalker to escape into hyperspace. Ventress broke off and reported to Tyranus, who had her deliver a false message to Jabba that Skywalker had killed Rotta. On Tatooine, Skywalker and Tano split up, with Tano delivering Rotta to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] while Skywalker acted as the decoy. Taking matters into his own hands, Tyranus confronted Skywalker out on the Dune sea, and the two crossed blades. Tyranus managed to cut open Skywalker's weighted backpack, that supposedly contained Rotta, only to discover the ruse, though he was unsurprised and prepared, having left a trio of [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] as Jabba's palace to ambush Tano. Skywalker broke off to rescue her, as Dooku planned, expecting the MagnaGuards to kill Tano while Skywalker confronted Jabba. The plan nearly worked, save for the fact that Tano defeated the droids and returned Rotta to Jabba. Darth Tyranus departed Tatooine and reported to Darth Sidious, who was largely unconcerned with the outcome of the scheme, having arranged it as a win-win situation.<ref name="TCWf" />

===Failed Negotiations on Rugosa===
{{Main|Mission to Rugosa}}

{{Dialogue|Ventress|If Yoda is indeed the Jedi warrior you believe he is, let him prove it. Allow me to send my best troops to capture him. If he escapes, join the Republic. But should my droids defeat Yoda, consider an alliance with the Separatists.|Katuunko|I did not request Yoda's presence here to test him in battle.|Yoda|Accept the challenge I do, Your Highness. Arrive by nightfall, I ''will''.|attr=Asajj Ventress places the terms of the competition; Yoda accepts|audio=YodaAcceptsChallenge.flac|src=<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}

[[File:Mission_to_Rugosa3.png|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress is prevented from assassinating King Katuunko by Jedi Master Yoda's intervention.]]
When the Republic opened negotiations with the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]] to build a military base in their territory, the Confederacy took steps to counter this. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was ambushed en route to [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] for face-to-face negotiations with the Toydarian [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]], and Asajj Ventress arrived instead, negotiating on behalf of the Confederacy. However, Yoda and a squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] were able to land on Rugosa and contact Katuunko. Ventress, having brought a battalion of [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]], proposed a challenge; if Yoda and his clones could survive Ventress' assault and reach Katuunko's position, the King would side with the Republic, but if Yoda failed, he would side with the Separatist Alliance.<ref name="Ambush" />

Yoda agreed to the terms, and spent the remainder of the day fighting his way through Ventress' forces. Yoda's success prompted Ventress to dispatch a force of [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka]] to reinforce her failing troops, violating the terms of the contest. However, even this measure failed, and Katuunko sided with the Republic, his decision backed up by this display of Separatist treachery. In response, Tyranus ordered Ventress to assassinate Katuunko. The Dark Acolyte made quick work of the King's [[Toydarian royal guard|guards]], but was prevented from killing Katuunko by Yoda's intervention. Yoda advised Ventress to surrender, but Ventress instead detonated a series of pre-planted explosive and used the ensuing distraction to flee the scene. Tyranus, who witnessed the event via holocom, remarked that it was a shame he wasn't there in person, a sentiment that Yoda echoed.<ref name="Ambush" />

===Assault on Kamino===
{{Main|Battle of Kamino/Legends}}

[[File:AnakinVentressDuel-Kamino.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Asajj Ventress duels Anakin Skywalker during the assault on Kamino.]]
As the Clone Wars wore on, the Confederacy concocted a bold plan to attack the Republic [[Cloning/Legends|Cloning]] [[Clone Labs|Laboratories]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Asajj Ventress infiltrated the planet as a spy, relaying intelligence to Grievous. The General attempted to quietly take the Republic [[Listening post/Legends|Listening post]] on the remote [[Rishi moon]] to allow for a surprise attack on Kamino, but failed when the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] staffing the facility scuttled it to prevent it from falling into Separatist hands.<ref name="Rookies" /> Grievous decided to go ahead with the attack anyway, though an intercepted transmission between him and Ventress alerted the Republic to this.<ref name="ARCtroopers" />

Using diversionary tactics, Grievous sent the majority of the fleet in a frontal assault on [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], while debris dropped into the ocean below was actually disguised components for [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|Trident drills]] that were assembled by [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droids]]. Ventress linked up with Grievous when he breached the city. This meeting was the first proper face-to-face introduction between the two, as their first encounter was a vicious fight, and all subsequent interactions had been via holocom. The two bickered over who held command of the mission, during which Ventress derided Grievous's skill and effectiveness, before the two separated to pursue their respective objectives. Ventress makes for the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] storage facility within the Tipoca City laboratories to secure the [[Clone template/Legends|prime DNA sample]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. While she successfully breached the lab and stole the sample, she was confronted by Anakin Skywalker. The two had a brief duel through the corridor outside the storage lab before Ventress fled. Skywalker pursued her to the landing platforms on the City exterior, where they renewed their contest. Skywalker managed to momentarily disable Ventress and take back the DNA sample, though Ventress viciously fought back and very nearly reclaimed it, only to find herself cornered by a battalion of Clone troopers. Ventress managed to escape on board Grievous' escape pod as the General fled the lost battle, fresh from his own contest with Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="ARCtroopers" />

===Asajj Ventress' subsequent missions===
{{Main|Skirmish on Coruscant (Clone Wars)|Mission to Mon Gazza|Mission to Zygerria/Legends|Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Valahari}}
{{Quote|I think you had better convince me that you are a net gain to my efficiency, Asajj. [&hellip;] Right now, you are a very expensive ally, Asajj. Right now, you are costing me more than you're worth.|Darth Tyranus|<ref name="Y:DarkRendezvous" />}}
Asajj Ventress was involved in the retrieval of intelligence from a [[Unidentified CIS spy senator|CIS-affiliated Republic Senator]], working with the agent [[Messo]]. The Senator was betrayed, and Ventress cut him down with one of her lightsabers. Ventress then killed the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] led by Jedi Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] sent to retrieve the Senator, dueling Mundi and destroying their gunship in a bid to commandeer it. While Ventress managed to escape to [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], Mundi was told of the leaked intelligence and the rendezvous on Mon Gazza by the mortally wounded Senator before he expired. Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano were sent in pursuit of Ventress and Messo, and eventually discovered the agents they were set to meet with. During the local podrace, the Jedi pursued the racer [[San Maxus|Maxus]], secretly the CIS agent in possession of the data disk the intelligence was stored on, and Ventress intervened, dueling Ahsoka Tano atop a moving [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]. Ventress managed to retrieve the disk from Maxus, though Skywalker, who was riding alongside on a speeder bike, destroyed it with the Force. Ventress fled the scene.<ref name="TCWV2CC">''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]''</ref>

[[File:Ventress_vs._Plo_Koon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress dueling Plo Koon on Khorm.]]

During the Battle of [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]], the Confederate forces being routed by the Republic troops under the command of [[Tauht]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]],contacted Darth Tyranus for assistance, who dispatched Asajj Ventress. Ventress' arrival on the planet revealed the existence of a Separatist [[Weather-control station]], which caused a gap in the ever-present storm that blanketed the world to open and allow Ventress to fly in and land, while keeping out the Republic fighter wings. Ventress managed to infiltrate the Republic base and kill Tauht, and the base was overrun. Interrogating [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|one of the captured officers]] for the locations of Fisto and Koon, Ventress went and ambushed them. While her assassin droids initiated a firefight with the Clone troopers, Ventress had a brief bout with Plo Koon, ending it by bringing down an avalanche on the battlefield. She led her surviving forces in a search for enemy survivors, though she was forced to break off and return to the Confederacy's base, where the captives had escaped. Deducing that they intended to flee to the Republic staging area, Ventress led a military force to destroy it and break the Republic's foothold on Khorm. However, she was undone by Koon and Fisto, who managed to reach the Separatist base and destroy the weather-control station. The Jedi came to reinforce the Republic forces as their fleet destroyed the Confederate battle group. Ventress was again confronted by Plo Koon, but broke off and fled the field when Kit Fisto came to his aid.<ref name="ISofR">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic]]''</ref>

Darth Tyranus began dealing with the previously neutral world of [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]], who provided his forces with their advanced engines. The increased performance of his fighters as a result prompted the Republic to intervene, demanding the Valahari stop selling these engines to the Confederacy. The Valahari refused, so the Republic blockaded the planet. In order to make the Republic forces appear the aggressors, and gain the allegiance of the world, Darth Tyranus had Asajj Ventress sabotage the vessel of the Valahari Viscount [[Harko Vane]], destroying it. The manipulations of the Sith were initially successful, with the late Viscount's son, [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]], becoming an ace pilot within the Confederacy military, while Vane's widow, [[Elodore Vane|Elodore]], began contemplating marriage to Tyranus. The Dark Lord's machinations were eventually laid bare, and he was banished from Valahari, though too late to save Tofen, who died in combat.<ref name="HotC">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Hero of the Confederacy]]''</ref>

===The Rescue of Nute Gunray===
{{Main|Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends}}

During a "diplomatic" mission to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], one of the Confederate chairpersons, [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], had gotten himself captured by Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and he was ensconced aboard the Star Destroyer [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] for transport and interrogation. Both Darth Tyranus and Darth Sidious were aware that their cowardly [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] ally wouldn't last long under Jedi interrogation, so Tyranus sent Asajj Ventress to either free Gunray, or silence him. Sidious was initially hesitant of Tyranus' proposal, Ventress' numerous failures having eroded his faith in her, though he ultimately approved his apprentice's course of action. Tyranus reminded Ventress that this mission had no margin for error, and her credibility was on the line. As the ''Tranquility'' went under way, a number of Separatist boarding pods appeared and latched onto the ship, deploying a force of Super battle droids and Ventress. While the droids distracted the security forces aboard the vessel, Ventress executed a clone survivor in the hangar and made off with his comlink, using it to monitor the communication chatter. She infiltrated the engine room, pre-planting numerous explosives throughout the chamber. To get the attention of the Jedi, Ventress aggressively broke into the ''Tranquility'' detention level and attacked the guards, and engaged Ahsoka Tano. The duel was cut short by the arrival of Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], who had been leading the security forces against the droids. Ventress triggered the explosives in the engine room and fled the detention level, with Unduli in close pursuit. However, Tano was ordered to remain behind and guard Gunray.<ref name="CoD" />

[[File:Duel_on_Tranquility.png|thumb|right|250px|Ventress engages Ahsoka Tano and Luminara Unduli aboard the ''Tranquility''.]]

In the ruined engine room, Unduli and Ventress fought in earnest. Luminara provoked Ventress into a rage when she criticized the Acolytes dueling skills, and Ventress got the better of her, pinning her under a series of industrial pipes. As Ventress moved to finish Unduli, Tano arrived and drove her off before freeing Unduli. The two Jedi worked together against Ventress, as Ventress had planned, and she signaled her associate, the turncoat [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] [[Faro Argyus/Legends|Faro Argyus]] to make his move in the absence of the Jedi. Argyus had been a longtime sleeper agent of Tyranus. Argyus killed the other guards and freed Gunray, and the two hijacked a small frigate in the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} docking bay. Ventress outmaneuvered the Jedi and rendezvoused with the frigate in a Republic escape pod. Unfortunately for Argyus, Ventress killed him in a fit of hubris after he slighted her, though Gunray was unconcerned. The Republic would attempt to track down the Viceroy and recapture him, tracking the Republic frigate used for his escape, but the Sith expected such a move, and lured the Jedi to General [[Grievous's castle/Legends|Grievous's castle]] in the [[Vassek system/Legends|Vassek system]], both as a trap and a test for [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] himself.<ref name="CoD" /><ref name="LoG">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>

===Expulsion and Retaliation of Asajj Ventress===
{{Main|Battle of Sullust/Legends|Mission to Serenno}}
{{Quote|Master, I need your help quickly. I am surrounded.''"<br />"''You have already lost the battle, child. I've ordered your reinforcements to return.''"<br />"''No! I will destroy the Jedi. I'll show you!''"<br />"''You have failed me for the last time. You are no longer my apprentice. And now, you shall die.|Asajj Ventress is betrayed by Darth Tyranus during the Battle of Sullust|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
[[File:SkywalkerVentressKenobi-Nightsisters.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress fends off Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi during the Battle of Sullust.]]
Ventress led the CIS space forces during the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], opposed by Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi. During the dogfighting, she singled out Kenobi, damaging his fighter, while she in turn was shot down by Skywalker. Both Ventress and Kenobi crash-landed on the Separatist flagship. While Ventress led the battle, Darth Tyranus received a communication from Darth Sidious. Ventress' increasing power had caused Sidious to view her as a threat; a potential violation of the Sith [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] he and his apprentice nominally adhered to. Sidious ordered her eliminated before she became too powerful to handle, and after initial resistance, Tyranus obeyed. When the wounded Ventress contacted him from her downed starfighter, calling for aid, Tyranus refused. The Dark Lord concealed his master's execution order and instead claimed that he was abandoning her because of her repeated failures. With no aid from Tyranus, Ventress limped out of her downed fighter and attempted to escape the ship, but was confronted by Kenobi and Skywalker. They demanded her to surrender, but she refused, brandishing her lightsabers and attacking them. While they fought, Tyranus ordered the flagship destroyed to ensure Ventress' death, forcing all the combatants to break off and attempt escape in their starfighters.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

Ventress limped away from the battle in her damaged [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|Ginivex fanblade]], drifting through space until discovered by the salvage vessel [[Raider (salvage freighter)/Legends|''Raider'']]. She killed the crew and hijacked the vessel, traveling to her original homeworld, [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. She was found by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] clan led by [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], who greeted her as one of their own, taking her in and treating her injuries. Awakening from her feverish slumber, Ventress swore an oath of vengeance against Tyranus. Talzin decides to help Ventress in her quest, sending the clan's two finest warriors, [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]] and [[Karis/Legends|Karis]], to accompany and aid her, as well as a set of captured Jedi lightsabers. Talzin also used [[Dathomir Magic|Nightsister Force-magic]] to cast a [[Force cloak|cloak of invisibility]] upon the trio.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

[[File:ShockerOnSerenno-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|250px|Tyranus demonstrates to the Nightsister assassins, led by Ventress, that he is never helpless.]]
With the Nightsister warrior pair in tow, Ventress traveled to [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] and breached [[Dooku's palace/Legends|Dooku's palace]]. The three darksiders made their way to the bedroom, where the Dark Lord lay sleeping. Ventress fired a poisoned dart at Tyranus, instantly awakening him, though also dulling his senses. Even with the poison hindering him, the Dark Lord was still a powerful opponent, quickly seizing the offensive and leaping at his assailant with his lightsaber. However, he remained unaware of her identity, due to his poison-dulled senses and her invisibility cloak, instead believing his lightsaber-wielding attackers to be Jedi. Ventress and the two Nightsisters narrowly managed to overcome Tyranus, disarming him. Despite this, the Dark Lord was far from helpless, and lashed out at his foes with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], sending them flying out of a bay window of his palace and disrupting their invisibility, though he failed to ascertain their identities.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

Shortly afterwards, Tyranus was contacted by Talzin. The Nightsister claimed to have learned of the assassination attempt on the Dark Lord, and was willing to provide him with a new warrior and bodyguard to replace Asajj Ventress. Tyranus accepted the offer, traveling to Dathomir.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

===Recruitment of Savage Opress===
{{Main|Battle at the Temple of Eedit|Showdown at Toydaria/Legends}}
[[File:OpressHalsey-Devaron.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Savage Opress engages the Jedi [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].]]

Talzin's offer for a new bodyguard and warrior took the shape of [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], one of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Secretly, Opress was an agent of Asajj Ventress, selected after a series of brutal combat exercises and reinforced by [[Dathomir Magic|Nightsister Force-spells]], turning him into a hulking brute. Opress was presented to Tyranus in [[Dooku's palace/Legends|his palace courtyard]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], and the Dark Lord was quick to put his new Acolyte to the test, sending Opress to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] to capture the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]]. While Opress questioned the wisdom behind a military attack on a Jedi temple, he was assured by Tyranus that the temple was a front for a Republic military base. Inserted into the chaotic battlefield in front of the Temple, Savage charged the edifice, cutting down the very Separatist battle droids aiding him in his rush to confront the enemy. The [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] fighting for the Republic were scarcely a challenge, and Opress was quickly facing the Jedi [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and his student [[Knox/Legends|Knox]]. While Halsey was a skilled opponent, he was disarmed and subdued by Opress' vastly superior physical strength, and was impaled with [[Savage's spear/Legends|his blade]]. Knox met a similar fate.<ref name="Monster" />

Tyranus was greatly satisfied with Opress' performance on Devaron, and began training him in knowledge of the Force immediately. Like his relative, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], Opress opted to train with the [[Savage Opress's lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]. In a marked difference from his training methods for his other Acolytes, Darth Tyranus trained him as a true [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], promising that the two may one day become powerful enough to contend with Darth Sidious and supplant him, enabling them to rule the galaxy side by side. However, Tyranus also showed himself to be a harsh mentor, heavily criticizing Opress' sloppy and brutish lightsaber technique, and took to torturing his student with Force lightning to provoke his hatred. By channeling this anger, the Zabrak warrior was able to strengthen his connection to the dark side. After this series of tests, Tyranus sent Opress to [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] to capture King Katuunko alive and haul him on his knees to the Dark Lord. Savage massacred the King's guards and subdued the monarch himself, but was confronted by Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi before he could make his escape. In the ensuing duel, Katuunko managed to escape the Acolyte, so Opress killed him in the heat of combat. Fending off the Jedi, Opress escaped with Katuunko's corpse.<ref name="WotM" />

Tyranus was less than pleased with Opress' performance, having specified he needed Katuunko alive. Deriding the Zabrak as an "ignorant beast", the Dark Lord viciously tortured him with Force lightning, only to be interrupted by his old assassin: Asajj Ventress. Opress revealed his true colors as Ventress' agent, and the two banded together to defeat Tyranus. The duel was swift and brutal, and the Dark Lord was driven onto his back foot by his two opponents, until he began retaliating with Force lighting. Able to easily match Ventress as a duelist, Tyranus focused the brunt of this assault on Opress, who was driven to his knees. Derided and scorned by both of his masters for his failure to cope with this attack, the enraged Zabrak turned on both. In the resulting three-way free-for-all duel, Tyranus and Ventress drove back Opress before escaping through an escape hatch. Before Opress could pursue, he was confronted by Kenobi and Skywalker, who had followed him from Toydaria. While Opress engaged the Jedi, Tyranus and Ventress renewed their contest in the corridors of the cruiser. The Dathomirian was ultimately no match for her former master, and was forced to flee aboard an escape pod. Darth Tyranus informed the droid forces aboard the cruiser of Savage Opress' treachery, and the Dark Jedi was forced to break off from his duel with the Jedi to defend himself. Opress destroyed the droids and escaped the cruiser aboard a hijacked [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|solar sailer]].<ref name="WotM" />

===Ventress' Rehabilitation and Final Disappearance===
{{Main|Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)}}

[[File:Asajjtank_copy.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Asajj Ventress recuperates in a bacta tank on Boz Pity.]]
Asajj Ventress eventually resurfaced on [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], where she was receiving medical treatments and cybernetic enhancements with the [[Boz Pity Confederacy base|Confederacy's medical base]] on the planet. She was widely believed to be dead, though Obi-Wan Kenobi refused to believe these reports, obsessively hunting across the galaxy for clues as to Ventress' whereabouts. Kenobi was eventually led to Boz Pity, and took part in the Republic invasion of the planet. During the battle, Kenobi quietly infiltrated the base and discovered Ventress recuperating in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|Bacta tank]]. Tyranus was present, confronting Kenobi and essentially siccing the wild Ventress on him. Their battle broke through the outer walls of the complex, sending Kenobi falling to the battlefield outside, Ventress in close pursuit. Anakin Skywalker leapt to his master's aid, though he was restrained by Kenobi, who was determined to redeem Ventress.<ref name="Obsession5">[[Obsession 5|''Obsession'' 5]]</ref><ref name="Obsession4">[[Obsession 4|''Obsession'' 4]]</ref>

While Ventress engaged Kenobi and Skywalker, Tyranus quietly fled the base. As he made his way on foot to his evac ship, he was confronted by Mace Windu, though the Dark Lord only dueled the Jedi Swordmaster briefly, opting to delay him with a pair of [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] while he continued to make a run for it. Kenobi sighted Tyranus, and pointed out to the raging Ventress that her master was leaving without her, abandoning her again. Ventress broke off from her duel with Kenobi and Skywalker and rushed to rejoin Tyranus. However, the unimpressed Dark Lord ordered one of his MagnaGuards to gun her down, knowing that she would never reach the evac site in time, and not wanting her to become a Republic captive. While Tyranus fled the planet, Ventress attacked Kenobi with a shard of metal, only to be cut down by Skywalker. Asajj Ventress apparently died in the arms of her nemesis, providing him with intel on the upcoming Separatist attack on Coruscant, and even acknowledging that Kenobi may have been right about her possible redemption. In truth, Ventress slowed her bodily functions with a Sith meditation technique and faked her own death. When her "body" was placed on one of the Republic medical, she awoke from her meditation mid-journey and hijacked the vessel, disappearing to parts unknown.<ref name="Obsession5" />

===Creation of the Morgukai Shadow Army===
{{Main|Morgukai Shadow Army}}

Seeking to establish a viable counter-measure to the Republic's [[Cloning/Legends|clone army]], the Confederacy recruited one of the last remaining [[Morgukai]], [[Bok]], using him as the [[Clone template/Legends|template]] for a new clone army. Sora Bulq was given control of this operation, with Tol Skorr operating as his lieutenant. To train the Morgukai clones, Bulq recruited Anzati [[Assassin/Legends|assassin teachers]] from [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]]. The necessary cloning facilities were constructed in the magma chambers beneath the capital city on Saleucami, also doubling as the training ground and all powered by the geothermal power stations also built into these catacombs. The clones and their instructors were all equipped with [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] alloy blades, to allow them to combat Jedi, though the source of these weapons is unknown. According to the assassin trainer [[Rath Kelkko]], the Morgukai clones adapted quickly to the Anzati methods and techniques, though he noted that proper mastery required years.<ref name="Trackdown" />

[[File:TholmeBulq.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sora Bulq attacks Tholme within the Morgukai cloning facility.]]

However, Sora Bulq's frequent trips to Anzat to recruit trainers for the army alerted the Jedi to something amiss, and the Jedi Tholme and Aayla Secura were sent to investigate. Tholme followed the trail to Saleucami, and after witnessing Bulq and his cohorts reporting to Tyranus within the Morgukai cloning facility, he contacted the Jedi and informed them of the situation. However, Bulq sensed his presence and attacked the Jedi. As the Dark Acolyte battled back and forth with his former comrade, he revealed the circumstances of his conversion to the dark side of the Force, and his reasons for saving Tholme's life then. In his rage-addled state of mind, Bulq stated that having saved Tholme's life then gave him the right to take it now. Tholme, aware that he couldn't defeat Sora Bulq, opted to evade him and lose himself in the maze of passages and catacombs that made up the cloning facility. Bulq was forced to contend with Tholme's campaign of sabotage while he prepared for the impending Republic invasion.<ref name="Trackdown" />

Concurrently with these events, Quinlan Vos pursued his obsession with finding the "second Sith" - Darth Sidious - coming into conflict with the Anzati assassin [[Sajé Tasha]]. However, Vos was forced to set aside his quest when he was selected by Master [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] to be his second in command during the upcoming [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]], his intimate knowledge of both Anzati and Morgukai being judged invaluable. Darth Sidious, who had had a personal interest in Quinlan Vos for many years, expected the Jedi's obsession with finding him to bring about his turn to the dark side.<ref name="Trackdown" />

===Fall from grace===
{{Quote|'''Nikkos Tyris:''' The weak always fear the strong growing up to replace them."<br />"'''Nejaa Halcyon:''' And the foolish always see themselves as strong.|Nikkos Tyris and Nejaa Halcyon on Susevfi|<ref name="IJedi" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Saleucami.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Quinlan Vos fights with the Republic forces during the Siege of Saleucami.]]
The Republic invasion of Saleucami effectively pinned the CIS forces on-planet, preventing them from widely deploying the Morgukai Shadow Army. However, the Shadow Army was used against the Republic forces, and their high level of combat effectiveness inflicted heavy casualties on the Republic, despite their being led by seven Jedi and bolstered by Master [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]]' [[Battle meditation/Legends|Battle meditation]]. Quinlan Vos fought for the Republic, awaiting Darth Tyranus' summons while maintaining his cover. Despite the effectiveness of the Morgukai soldiers, the Separatist forces were still forced to give ground as the Jedi attacked their strategic weak points. All the while, Tholme remained hidden within the maze of tunnels that made up the below-ground Confederate base, and was intensifying his campaign of sabotage. During a report to the Dark Lord, Tyranus demanded that Tholme be removed, though he ultimately wrote him off as a distraction rather than a true threat. Tol Skorr delivered Tyranus' summons to Quinlan Vos via Vos' "agent" Khaleen Hentz. The following day, Vos and Aayla Secura led a battalion of clone troopers through the streets of the Saleucami capital city, encountering Tol Skorr on the battlefield. Quinlan used his pursuit of Skorr to separate himself from the Republic forces before the two of them disengaged and entered the Confederate base to report to their master. Tyranus ordered Sora Bulq to mastermind the assassination of Oppo Rancisis, removing the aid of his battle meditation, and Quinlan Vos to hunt down Tholme and end his campaign of sabotage. Tyranus then placed Sora Bulq in overall command of the Confederacy's forces, as the Dark Lord's affairs elsewhere required his attention.<ref name="SWRTSOS">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami]]''</ref>

Quinlan Vos located Tholme quickly, finding him meditating above an underground lava lake deep within the catacombs. Vos revealed to Tholme that he had come to believe that Sora Bulq was the "second Sith" and he wanted Tholme to join with him and kill the supposed Darth Sidious. Tholme pressed Vos for his reasons, and Quinlan confessed to [[Raid on Kiffu|executing]] [[Sheyf]] Tinte Vos. Tholme attempted to calm Vos, knowing his former student was in danger of falling to the dark side permanently. Vos only became enraged, and attacked Tholme. The duel ended when Vos shorted out Tholme's lightsaber with his pure [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] gauntlet, and Quinlan delivered his final ultimatum; join him or die. Tholme refused, though before Vos could kill him, the rock ledge they stood on crumbled, and Tholme fell into the lava lake. Meanwhile, Tol Skorr led the Morgukai troops in an attack to distract the Jedi and Republic forces, allowing Sora Bulq and his cadre of Anzati assassins to infiltrate Oppo Rancisis' meditation chamber. However, Rancisis sensed the presence of the assassins and moved to defend himself, killing all the assassins, only to be impaled from behind by Bulq.<ref name="SWRTSOS" />

Quinlan Vos returned to the Republic HQ to find his fellow Jedi mourning Rancisis' death. As he was second in command to Rancisis, Vos was placed in command of the Republic forces. As Rancisis kept his battle plans in his head, only revealing them during their execution, Vos was forced to use his [[Psychometry/Legends|psychometric]] abilities to literally "read" the plans from Rancisis' corpse. In truth, Vos simply made up his own, ordering the Republic air forces to attack the shield to cover for Vos and Aayla Secura while they infiltrated the Confederacy's base and destroyed their power centers. While Secura planted the explosives, Vos went alone to the Separatist command center, where Bulq and the other lieutenants were reporting to Tyranus. Vos then explained the entire battle plan to Tyranus, and the Morgukai [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] Bok was dispatched to hunt down Secura. While satisfied with Vos' actions, Tyranus felt that one final test was necessary. Tol Skorr arrived with a captive Khaleen Hentz, and Tyranus revealed that she was actually an agent of his who had infiltrated Quinlan Vos' spy ring to keep the Dark Lord posted on its activities. In addition, she was to seduce the Jedi Master and gain his confidence. The nature of the test was to provoke Vos' anger and push him into killing Hentz. Hentz pleaded with Vos to use his psychometric abilities and learn the truth about her feelings for him, and Vos obliged. Quinlan Vos refused to kill her, instead cutting her bonds and declaring himself a Jedi.<ref name="SWRTSOS" />

[[File:Bulq_duel.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sora Bulq and Quinlan Vos fight after the latter's treachery is revealed.]]
While Sora Bulq taunted Vos, Bok contacted the command center, revealing that Aayla Secura was not in the power plant as Vos said she was; Quinlan Vos had lied. At this moment, Tholme revealed himself, having faked his death during his duel with Vos so he could watch and wait to see what Vos would do. Tholme helped Vos fend off the Anzati assassins, and the Jedi and Hentz moved to flee, only to have their path blocked when Sora Bulq hurled his [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|shoto lightsaber]] at the door controls, triggering the security system. Tyranus then gave his Acolytes permission to kill Tholme and Vos. Bulq focused on Tholme, while Skorr attacked Vos. While the duelists raged through the control center, the CIS base began falling apart, the lava pumping stations having been sabotaged by Aayla Secura, while she fought Bok just outside the entrance to the chamber. Vos and Skorr fought their way to a ledge above a lava lake, and Skorr was thrown off the ledge into the lava by an enraged Vos. Tholme fared considerably worse against Sora Bulq, a former Jedi lightsaber instructor and practitioner of [[Form VII/Legends|Vaapad]], and he was disarmed and thrown to the ground. However, before Bulq could execute Tholme, Vos intervened, declaring that he would kill Bulq, whom he believed to be the "second Sith". Tyranus, whose communication link remained open, ordered Vos to give in to the dark side and execute Tholme and Khaleen, as this was the only way he would survive. While Quinlan Vos and Sora Bulq raged against each other, Quinlan struggled with his own inner darkness, his battle aided by Aayla Secura's meditative connection to him. His mind clear, Vos turned and cut down Sora Bulq, slicing him open through the shoulder. Tyranus was ultimately unconcerned by the death of Bulq and Skorr, or the loss of Vos, citing that the victory of the Sith was inevitable.<ref name="SWRTSOS" />

[[File:EscapeFromDagu-cover.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Artel Darc dueling Shaak Ti on Dagu.]]
[[Artel Darc]] meanwhile soon met his end during the [[Battle of Dagu]], where he commanded the CIS forces. Coordinated by Darc, the Confederacy's droid armies subjugated the native [[Rybet/Legends|Rybet]] population, and established a military base managed by enslaved prisoners of war, a combination of Rybets and captured clone troopers. Among the prisoners was a courier with damaging information on the Republic, and Darc was tasked by Tyranus with apprehending him. However, Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] was also among the prisoners, and she went about taking advantage of discontent among the slaves to start a revolt. The situation fell apart, and Artel Darc personally went blade-to-blade with Shaak Ti, and presumably perished.<ref name="EfD">''[[Escape from Dagu]]''</ref>

Towards the end of the war, [[Nikkos Tyris]] would follow. When the Jedi located his compound on [[Susevfi]], following rumors of Sith cultists, they confronted Tyris and two of his Jensaarai apprentices. After a momentary dialogue, the Dark Acolyte led the charge against the Jedi, focusing on [[Nejaa Halcyon]]. After a brief duel, Tyris brought down his opponent with a telekinetic onslaught, which Halcyon had no counter against, as he lacked such abilities. Disarming Halcyon, Tyris gloated for a moment before moving to finish the Jedi, impaling him. However, Halcyon used [[tutaminis]] to absorb the energy of Tyris' lightsaber blade, and channel it into a telekinetic counterattack. Nikkos Tyris was pulverized, his every bone shattered, and his body exploded in a blast of Dark Side energy, collapsing the compound dome. All but four of Tyris' apprentices died, and all the Jedi, save Halcyon, escaped. Tyris' surviving apprentices went on to reform the Jensaarai with the intent of defending themselves against the Jedi, free of Tyris' influence.<ref name="IJedi" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Dark Acolytes defended the ruins of the [[Sith Academy (Umbara)|Sith Academy]] on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] from invaders. When a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|unidentified Jedi Knight]] tried to infiltrate the academy ruins around the time of the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] was taking place, these [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] sorcerers aggressively tried to defeat the Jedi Knight. Many of them were killed or defeated when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] eventually made it into the academy.<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures video game">{{TCWA|Battle of Umbara}}</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|In fact, the Jedi believed that they could oversee the galaxy better than we could, and they were willing to perpetuate a war simply to leave us defenseless and susceptible to their treason. Their vaunted Temple was a fort, their base of operations. They came to me with tales of having killed General Grievous - a ''cyborg'', no less - and sought to arrest me because I refused to take them at their word that the fighting was suddenly over, the Separatists defeated.|Darth Sidious, as Palpatine, scapegoats the Jedi Order for his - and by extension, the Dark Acolyte's - activities during the Clone War|<ref name="TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Inquisitor-TFUCG.png|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial Inquisitor, one of the many malign Force-wielders that superseded the Dark Acolytes, standing over a fallen Jedi.]]
The very existence of the Dark Acolytes as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] servants to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] served Darth Sidious' concoction by eroding public faith in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], as some citizens came to believe that Jedi could no longer be trusted, and any of them were capable of treachery. In fact, when Sidious declared the Jedi enemies of state and enacted [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], he claimed that Tyranus had never really left the Jedi Order, and was instead acting as their agent in initiating the Clone Wars; effectively scapegoating the Jedi for all of his own actions.<ref name="TRoDV" /> In keeping with this propaganda, the Dark Acolytes themselves were likely labelled as Jedi agents,<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref><ref name="DE2">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''</ref>

During the war, Sidious as Palpatine assigned the Republic officer [[Trachta]] with investigating and capturing Jedi defecting to the Confederacy, and Trachta was heavily injured in the line of duty.<ref name="ReCG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> This incident no doubt left Trachta with a healthy distrust of Force-sensitives, and he was later involved in an [[Anti-Sith conspiracy|attempted coup]] to wrest control of the Galactic Empire, feeling that power shouldn't be left in the hands of the Force-wielders, be they Jedi Knights or, in this case, Sith Lords.<ref name="SWEB">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Betrayal]]''</ref>

Several force-sensitive separatists captured during the Clone Wars were held at a prison known as [[The Prism]]. Even after the Clone Wars had ended, they remained alive and incarcerated within until the [[Ghost Prison incident]]. Darth Vader, Moff Trachta, and lieutenant [[Laurita Tohm]] traveled to the prison, with Trachta exacting his vengeance by killing a [[Unidentified Dark Jedi Padawan|Dark Jedi Padawan]] who had wounded him during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Ghost Prison 3>[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3]]</ref> [[Nax Cirvan]], another force sensitive separatist held within the Prism, was offered a chance at freedom in exchange for helping Vader suppress a treasonous plot by headmaster [[Gentis]] of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].<ref name="Ghost Prison 4>[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 4]]</ref> Although Nax assisted Vader, the Sith lord would ultimately betray the former Dark Acolyte, alongside the other freed prisoners, rigging their transport to explode.<ref name="Ghost Prison 5>[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 5]]</ref>

However, perhaps the greatest impact of the Dark Acolytes was the formation of the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]]. After [[Nikkos Tyris]]' death and the destruction of his training facility at the hands of the Jedi, only four of his students survived. These four reformed the Jensaarai with the goal of defending themselves from the Jedi Order, adhering to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] despite their reverence for Sith traditions. While they vilified and feared the Jedi Order for decades, they were eventually approached by Grand Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]], and made peace with them.<ref name="JvS" />

On a more minor note, Asajj Ventress was worshipped as a goddess of [[Death/Legends|Death]] on [[Mauk]], with ritualistic sacrifices dedicated to her name.<ref name="Obsession1">[[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Assajj_concept-art.jpg|thumb|left|130px|Concept art of Asajj Ventress, effectively the first Dark Acolyte.]]
Technically, the first appearance of the Dark Acolytes was in the [[1998]] novel, [[I, Jedi]], with the character [[Nikkos Tyris]]. However, Tyris' connection to Darth Tyranus, whose character hadn't yet been conceived, would not be elaborated on until the release of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 116]]'' in the 2000s. The first Acolyte that was created explicitly to be Tyranus' apprentice was [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who was based on unused concept art for the Count himself.<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> She made her debut in the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' animated shorts, becoming [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] nemesis throughout the second season. She would become a recurring villain in the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' comic series, though she would ironically become the personal opponent of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] throughout the various story arcs, rather than Skywalker.

The number of Dark Jedi servants to Darth Tyranus would be bolstered by the release of ''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]'', which featured [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] and [[Rhad Tarn]], and ''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]'', which introduced [[Tol Skorr]], [[Kadrian Sey]], and most notably, [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] was the primary villain of the game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''. [[Saato]], [[Trenox]], [[Karoc]], [[Vinoc]] and the [[Doppelgänger of Dooku]] were all boss characters introduced in ''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]'', and were each killed off in short order. Other minions included the [[Dark Acolyte Trio]] featured in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' game]], and from whom the organization derived its name.

Most of the surviving Dark Acolytes were gradually killed off in storylines leading into [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Tyranus himself was executed by Skywalker during the events of the movie, which effectively heralded the end of the Dark Acolytes.

When the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series debuted, beginning with [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]], the character of Asajj Ventress was featured as a recurring antagonist, though the existence of the other Dark Acolytes (save Quinlan Vos, albeit serving for the Republic) was effectively overlooked.<ref name="WotManotated">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}: Many of the Jedi's comments towards the start of the episode suggest that Ventress was Dooku's only Dark Jedi servant prior to Savage Opress' recruitment</ref> This article assumes that Savage Opress was recruited into the Dark Acolytes when he was apprenticed to Darth Tyranus, though it remains to be seen whether or not the existence of the organization has been completely retconned.
